rows.english: The checked primary assessment establishes exact identity and South African distribution only. It does not establish edible parts, food-use preparation, picking dates or yield; claims for a different Lycium species are not transferred.
rows.zu: Ukuhlolwa kokuqala okuhloliwe kuqinisekisa kuphela ubunikazi obuqondile nokusabalala e-South Africa. Akuqinisekisi izingxenye ezidliwayo, ukulungiswa kokudla, izinsuku zokuvuna noma isivuno; okushiwo ngolunye uhlobo lwe-Lycium akudluliselwa kulolu.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya mantlha e hlahlobilweng e tiisa feela boitsebiso bo nepahetseng le kabo ya Afrika Borwa. Ha e tiise dikarolo tse jewang, tokiso ya dijo, matsatsi a kotulo kapa chai; ditlaleho tsa mofuta o mong wa Lycium ha di fetisetswe ho ona.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wo sungula lowu kambisisiweke wu tiyisisa ntsena leswaku i ximilana xihi hi ku kongoma ni ku hangalaka ka xona eAfrika-Dzonga. A wu tiyisisi swiphemu leswi dyiwaka, ku lulamisiwa ka swakudya, masiku yo tshovela kumbe ntshovelo; leswi vuriweke hi muxaka wun’wana wa Lycium a swi hundziseriwi eka lowu.
rows.ve: Ṱhoḓisiso ya u thoma yo ṱolwaho i khwaṱhisedza fhedzi vhuvha ho teaho na u phaḓalala Afrika Tshipembe. A i khwaṱhisedzi zwipiḓa zwi ḽiwaho, kulugisele kwa zwiḽiwa, maḓuvha a khaṋo kana khaṋo; zwine zwa bulwa nga luṅwe lushaka lwa Lycium a zwi pfukiselwi kha ulu.

rows.st: Temoso ena e hlakileng e thibela ponelopele ya dijo tse tlwaelehileng tsa lelapa. Ho beha ka dinako tse sa tsitsang selemo kaofela ha ho etswe khalendara ya ho fumaneha ha dijo tse jewang.
rows.ts: Xitsundzuxo lexi nga erivaleni xi sivela ku vhumbha swakudya swa ntolovelo swa le kaya. Ku tswala hi minkarhi leyi nga tiyelangiki lembe hinkwaro a ku endliwi khalendara ya ku kumeka ka swakudya leswi dyiwaka.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo iyi i re khagala i thivhela u bvumba zwiḽiwa zwo ḓoweleaho zwa muṱa. U aṋwa nga zwifhinga zwi sa dzikaho ṅwaha woṱhe a zwi itwi khaḽenda ya u wanala ha zwiḽiwa zwi ḽiwaho.

rows.english: Year 4 Beaumont: approximately 0.6–0.8 kg/tree (the year-4 basis is not explicit); year 5: 2–10 kg/tree Wet In Shell (WIS); year 8: about 16 kg/tree; year 13–14: up to 35 kg/tree WIS. SAMAC says area differences are guaranteed. This is a source reference, not a validated local schedule; it cannot seed edible kernel kg or a universal interpolated curve.
rows.zu: Unyaka 4 we-Beaumont: cishe 0.6–0.8 kg/tree (isisekelo sonyaka 4 asicaciswanga); unyaka 5: 2–10 kg/tree Wet In Shell (WIS); unyaka 8: cishe 16 kg/tree; unyaka 13–14: kufika ku-35 kg/tree WIS. I-SAMAC ithi umehluko wezindawo uqinisekisiwe. Lokhu kuwumthombo wokubheka, akulona uhlelo lwendawo oluqinisekisiwe; akunakugcwalisa ama-kg ezinhlamvu ezidliwayo noma ijika elixhumanisa yonke iminyaka kuzo zonke izindawo.
rows.st: Selemo sa 4 sa Beaumont: hoo e ka bang 0.6–0.8 kg/tree (motheo wa selemo sa 4 ha o a hlakiswa); selemo sa 5: 2–10 kg/tree Wet In Shell (WIS); selemo sa 8: hoo e ka bang 16 kg/tree; selemo sa 13–14: ho fihla ho 35 kg/tree WIS. SAMAC e re diphapang tsa dibaka di tiile. Ena ke tshupiso ya mohlodi, eseng lenaneo la lehae le netefaditsweng; e ke ke ya tlatsa kg tsa dithollo tse jewang kapa mola o hokahanyang dilemo tsohle bakeng sa dibaka tsohle.
rows.ts: Lembe ra 4 ra Beaumont: kwalomu ka 0.6–0.8 kg/tree (masungulo ya lembe ra 4 a ma hlamuseriwanga kahle); lembe ra 5: 2–10 kg/tree Wet In Shell (WIS); lembe ra 8: kwalomu ka 16 kg/tree; lembe ra 13–14: ku fika eka 35 kg/tree WIS. SAMAC yi vula leswaku ku hambana ka tindhawu ku tiyile. Lexi i xihlovo xo languta, a hi nongonoko wa laha kaya lowu tiyisisiweke; a xi nge tati kg ta tindzoho leti dyiwaka kumbe layini leyi hlanganisaka malembe lama nga riki na tinhlayo eka tindhawu hinkwato.
rows.ve: Ṅwaha wa 4 wa Beaumont: hu ṱoḓaho u vha 0.6–0.8 kg/tree (mutheo wa ṅwaha wa 4 a wo ngo ṱalutshedzwa nga vhuḓalo); ṅwaha wa 5: 2–10 kg/tree Wet In Shell (WIS); ṅwaha wa 8: hu ṱoḓaho u vha 16 kg/tree; ṅwaha wa 13–14: u swika kha 35 kg/tree WIS. SAMAC i ri phambano dza fhethu dzo khwaṱha. Itshi ndi tshiko tsha u sedza, a si mbekanyamushumo yo khwaṱhisedzwaho ya henefho; a tshi koni u dadza kg dza mbeu dzi ḽiwaho kana mutevhe u ṱumanyaho miṅwaha i si na mbalo une wa tea fhethu hoṱhe.

rows.english: Grafted stock: first nuts around 3–5 years, depending on variety; seedlings usually 10–12 years and sometimes longer. SAMAC recommends removing flowers until year 3 during establishment. The existing KZN guide 4–5-year first-bearing reference remains qualified; nursery propagation must be recorded before applying it.
rows.zu: Izithombo ezixhunyelelwe: amantongomane okuqala cishe eminyakeni engu-3–5, kuya ngohlobo; ezikhuliswe ngembewu zivame ukuthatha iminyaka engu-10–12, ngezinye izikhathi ngaphezulu. I-SAMAC incoma ukususa izimbali kuze kube unyaka 3 ngesikhathi izitshalo zisazinza. Umthombo okhona we-KZN weminyaka engu-4–5 yokuqala ukuthela usenemibandela; indlela inkulisa ezalanise ngayo izitshalo kufanele ibhalwe ngaphambi kokuwusebenzisa.
rows.st: Dimela tse hlomathisitsweng: linate tsa pele hoo e ka bang dilemong tse 3–5, ho ya ka mofuta; tse hodisitsweng ka peo hangata di nka dilemo tse 10–12 mme ka dinako tse ding ho feta. SAMAC e kgothaletsa ho tlosa dipalesa ho fihlela selemo sa 3 nakong ya ho mela. Tshupiso e teng ya KZN ya ho qala ho beha dilemong tse 4–5 e ntse e na le dipehelo; mokgwa wa ho atisa dimela setsing sa dipeo o lokela ho rekotwa pele o e sebedisa.
rows.ts: Swimilana leswi tlhomiweke: timanga to sungula kwalomu ka malembe ya 3–5, ku ya hi muxaka; leswi kurisiweke hi mbewu swi tala ku teka malembe ya 10–12 naswona nkarhi wun’wana ku hundza. SAMAC yi bumabumela ku susa swiluva ku fika eka lembe ra 3 loko swimila swa ha sungula ku kula. Xihlovo lexi nga kona xa KZN xa ku sungula ku tswala eka malembe ya 4–5 xa ha ri ni swipimelo; ndlela leyi ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana yi swi andziseke ha yona yi fanele ku rhekhodiwa u nga si xi tirhisa.
rows.ve: Zwimela zwo ṱumanywaho: nḓuhu dza u thoma kha miṅwaha i ṱoḓaho u vha 3–5, zwi tshi ya nga lushaka; zwo aluswaho nga mbeu zwi anzela u dzhia miṅwaha ya 10–12 na tshiṅwe tshifhinga i fhiraho. SAMAC i themendela u bvisa maluvha u swika kha ṅwaha wa 3 musi zwimela zwi tshi kha ḓi simuwa. Tshiko tshi re hone tsha KZN tsha u thoma u aṋwa kha miṅwaha ya 4–5 tshi kha ḓi vha na nyimele; kuandadzele kwa zwimela kwa fhethu ha u zwi alusa ku tea u rekhodiwa musi ni sa athu u tshi shumisa.

rows.zu: Langkloof, Little Karoo, inhlabathi yohlobo lwe-sandy loam: inani lomkhiqizo elibekwe kwisabelomali ngonyaka 3 lingu-10,000 kg/ha. Lokhu kuwukucatshangwa kwesabelomali sebhizinisi lokuhweba, akusona isilinganiso esithathwe ensimini. Isabelomali asinikezi ukuminyana kwezihlahla, isiphunzi sokuxhunyelelwa noma uhlobo olutshalwayo okuhambisana nalezi zibalo; ungaguquli kube kg/tree, ukusebenzise esihlahleni esincane esizimele noma uxhumanise eminye iminyaka engabikwanga. Umthombo ucashunwe ezingxenyeni zetafula: isamba sisekholomu ethi Quantity, imigqa yemali yomkhiqizo we-Apple isebenzisa u-Kg; isisekelo sendawo yehektha elilodwa sibhalwe esihlokweni.
rows.st: Langkloof, Little Karoo, mobu wa sandy loam: palo ya sehlahiswa e behilweng tekanyetsong ya selemo sa 3 ke 10,000 kg/ha. Ena ke kgakanyo ya tekanyetso ya kgwebo ya temo, eseng tekanyo e entsweng tshimong. Tekanyetso ha e fane ka palo ya difate sebakeng, kutu ya ho hlomathisa kapa mofuta o lengwang tse tsamaellanang le dipalo tsena; o se fetole ho kg/tree, wa e sebedisa sefateng se senyane se ikemetseng kapa wa hokahanya dilemo tse ding tse sa tlalehwang. Qotso e sebedisa dikarolo tsa tafole: kakaretso e kholomong ya Quantity, mme mela ya lekeno la sehlahiswa sa Apple e sebedisa Kg; motheo wa sebaka sa hektare e le nngwe o boletswe sehloohong.
rows.ts: Langkloof, Little Karoo, misava ya sandy loam: nhlayo ya xikumiwa leyi vekiweke eka mpimanyeto wa lembe ra 3 i 10,000 kg/ha. Lexi i ku ringanyeta ka mpimanyeto wa bindzu ra vurimi, a hi mpimo lowu tekiweke ensin’wini. Mpimanyeto a wu nyiki nhlayo ya misinya endhawini, timitsu leti tlhomiweke kumbe muxaka lowu byariwaka leswi fambelanaka ni tinhlayo leti; u nga cinci ku va kg/tree, u swi tirhisa eka nsinya lowutsongo lowu nga woxe kumbe u hlanganisa malembe man’wana lama nga vikiwangiki. Ku tshaha ku tirhisa swiphemu swa tafula: ntsengo wu le ka kholomo ya Quantity, naswona mintila ya mali ya xikumiwa xa Apple yi tirhisa Kg; masungulo ya ndhawu ya hektara yin’we ma vuriwile eka nhlokomhaka.
rows.ve: Langkloof, Little Karoo, mavu a sandy loam: tshivhalo tsha tshibveledzwa tsho vhewaho kha mugaganyagwama wa ṅwaha wa 3 ndi 10,000 kg/ha. Iyi ndi khumbulelo ya mugaganyagwama wa bindu ḽa vhulimi, a si mupimo wo itwaho tsimuni. Mugaganyagwama a u ṋei tshivhalo tsha miri fhethu, midzi ya u ṱumanya kana lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho zwi tendelanaho na mbalo idzi; ni songo zwi shandula zwa vha kg/tree, na zwi shumisa kha muri muṱuku u re woṱhe kana na ṱumanya miṅwaha miṅwe i songo vhigiwaho. Tshiko tsho bulwaho tshi shumisa zwipiḓa zwa thebuḽu: ṱhanganyelo i kha khoḽomu ya Quantity, nahone mitalo ya mbuelo ya tshibveledzwa tsha Apple i shumisa Kg; mutheo wa fhethu ha hekithara nthihi wo bulwa kha ṱhoho.

Tekanyetso ha e fane ka palo ya difate sebakeng, kutu ya ho hlomathisa kapa mofuta o lengwang tse tsamaellanang le dipalo tsena; o se fetole ho kg/tree, wa e sebedisa sefateng se senyane se ikemetseng kapa wa hokahanya dilemo tse ding tse sa tlalehwang. Qotso e sebedisa dikarolo tsa tafole: kakaretso e kholomong ya Quantity, mme mela ya lekeno la sehlahiswa sa Apple e sebedisa Kg; motheo wa sebaka sa hektare e le nngwe o boletswe sehloohong.
rows.ts: Langkloof, Little Karoo, misava ya sandy loam: nhlayo ya xikumiwa leyi vekiweke eka mpimanyeto wa lembe ra 8 i 64,000 kg/ha. Lexi i ku ringanyeta ka mpimanyeto wa bindzu ra vurimi, a hi mpimo lowu tekiweke ensin’wini. Mpimanyeto a wu nyiki nhlayo ya misinya endhawini, timitsu leti tlhomiweke kumbe muxaka lowu byariwaka leswi fambelanaka ni tinhlayo leti; u nga cinci ku va kg/tree, u swi tirhisa eka nsinya lowutsongo lowu nga woxe kumbe u hlanganisa malembe man’wana lama nga vikiwangiki. Ku tshaha ku tirhisa swiphemu swa tafula: ntsengo wu le ka kholomo ya Quantity, naswona mintila ya mali ya xikumiwa xa Apple yi tirhisa Kg; masungulo ya ndhawu ya hektara yin’we ma vuriwile eka nhlokomhaka.
rows.ve: Langkloof, Little Karoo, mavu a sandy loam: tshivhalo tsha tshibveledzwa tsho vhewaho kha mugaganyagwama wa ṅwaha wa 8 ndi 64,000 kg/ha. Iyi ndi khumbulelo ya mugaganyagwama wa bindu ḽa vhulimi, a si mupimo wo itwaho tsimuni. Mugaganyagwama a u ṋei tshivhalo tsha miri fhethu, midzi ya u ṱumanya kana lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho zwi tendelanaho na mbalo idzi; ni songo zwi shandula zwa vha kg/tree, na zwi shumisa kha muri muṱuku u re woṱhe kana na ṱumanya miṅwaha miṅwe i songo vhigiwaho. Tshiko tsho bulwaho tshi shumisa zwipiḓa zwa thebuḽu: ṱhanganyelo i kha khoḽomu ya Quantity, nahone mitalo ya mbuelo ya tshibveledzwa tsha Apple i shumisa Kg; mutheo wa fhethu ha hekithara nthihi wo bulwa kha ṱhoho.

rows.english: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
rows.zu: Izithombo ezixhunyelelwe ngokuvamile ziqala ukuthela cishe eminyakeni engu-3–4 futhi zingaqhubeka zikhiqiza iminyaka engu-20 noma ngaphezulu ngaphansi kwezimo zomhlahlandlela. Izihlahla ezikhuliswe ngembewu ziyisimo esihlukile sezinto zokutshala. Kufanele kuhlolwe isithwathwa, izimo ezimanzi zokuqhakaza entwasahlobo, uhlobo olutshalwayo nokuzinza ensimini; ubude bokuphila abulona ijika lesivuno ngokweminyaka.
rows.st: Dimela tse hlomathisitsweng ka kakaretso di qala ho beha hoo e ka bang dilemong tse 3–4 mme di ka tswela pele ho hlahisa ka dilemo tse 20 kapa ho feta tlasa maemo a tataiso. Difate tse hodisitsweng ka peo ke taba e fapaneng ya dimela tsa ho jala. Serame, maemo a metsi nakong ya ho thunya selemo, mofuta o lengwang le ho mela tshimong di lokela ho hlahlojwa; bolelele ba bophelo ha se mola wa chai ka dilemo.
rows.ts: Swimilana leswi tlhomiweke hi ntolovelo swi sungula ku tswala kwalomu ka malembe ya 3–4 naswona swi nga ya mahlweni swi humesa ntshovelo ku ringana malembe ya 20 kumbe ku hundza ehansi ka swiyimo swa nkongomiso. Misinya leyi kurisiweke hi mbewu i xiyimo xin’wana xa swimilana swo byala. Ku fanele ku kambisisiwa gwitsi, ku tsakama loko swi rhumbuka hi ximun’wana, muxaka lowu byariwaka ni ku sungula ku kula ensin’wini; nkarhi wo hanya a hi layini ya ntshovelo hi malembe.
rows.ve: Zwimela zwo ṱumanywaho zwi anzela u thoma u aṋwa kha miṅwaha i ṱoḓaho u vha 3–4 nahone zwi nga bvela phanḓa zwi tshi bveledza kha miṅwaha ya 20 kana i fhiraho fhasi ha nyimele dza nyeletshedzo. Miri yo aluswaho nga mbeu ndi nyimele yo fhambanaho ya zwimela zwa u ṱavha. Hu tea u ṱolwa murotholo, nyimele dzo ṋukalaho musi zwi tshi ṱuma maluvha nga tshilimo, lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho na u simuwa tsimuni; vhulapfu ha vhutshilo a si mutevhe wa khaṋo nga miṅwaha.

rows.english: This is an annual, not a fruit tree. The account describes boiled leaves as a spinach substitute and pickling. It supplies no food harvest duration, kg/plant or exact leaf calendar.
rows.zu: Lesi yisitshalo sonyaka, asisona isihlahla sezithelo. Umbhalo uchaza amaqabunga abilisiwe esikhundleni sesipinashi nokugcinwa ngokufakwa kuviniga. Awunikezi ubude besikhathi sokuvuna ukudla, kg/plant noma ikhalenda eliqondile lamaqabunga.
rows.st: Sena ke sejalo sa selemo, eseng sefate sa ditholwana. Tlaleho e hlalosa makgasi a phehilweng e le sebaka sa spinach le ho boloka ka asene. Ha e fane ka nako ya kotulo ya dijo, kg/plant kapa khalendara e nepahetseng ya makgasi.
rows.ts: Lexi i xibyariwa xa lembe, a hi nsinya wa mihandzu. Tsalwa ri hlamusela matluka lama virisiweke ematshan’weni ya xipinichi ni ku hlayisa hi vhiniga. A ri nyiki nkarhi wa ku tshovela swakudya, kg/plant kumbe khalendara ya matluka hi ku kongoma.
rows.ve: Itshi ndi tshiliṅwa tsha ṅwaha, a si muri wa mitshelo. Muṱalutshedzo u bula maṱari o vhiliswaho sa tsha u ima vhuimoni ha spinach nahone na u vhulunga nga vhiniga. A u ṋei vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha khaṋo ya zwiḽiwa, kg/plant kana khaḽenda yo teaho ya maṱari.

rows.english: The source describes bright orange-red mature fruit. It does not give a picking calendar.
rows.zu: Umthombo uchaza izithelo ezivuthiwe ezibomvu okusawolintshi ngokugqamile. Awunikezi ikhalenda lokuvuna.
rows.st: Mohlodi o hlalosa ditholwana tse butswitseng tse kganyang ka mmala wa lamunu o mofubedu. Ha o fane ka khalendara ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xi hlamusela mihandzu leyi vupfeke ya muhlovo lowu vonakalaka wa xilamula xo tshwuka. A xi nyiki khalendara yo tshovela.
rows.ve: Tshiko tshi ṱalutshedza mitshelo yo vhibvaho i re na muvhala wa swiri u re na vhutswuku u penyaho. A tshi ṋei khaḽenda ya khaṋo.

rows.english: SANBI reports culinary uses but also toxic constituents and poisoning concerns. A preparation report is not a complete safe household recipe.
rows.zu: I-SANBI ibika ukusetshenziswa ekuphekeni kodwa futhi nezinto ezinobuthi nokukhathazeka ngokungenwa ubuthi. Ukubikwa kwendlela yokulungisa akuyona iresiphi ephelele ephephile yasekhaya.
rows.st: SANBI e tlaleha tshebediso ya ho pheha empa hape le dikarolo tse nang le tjhefo le matshwenyeho a ho tjhefuwa. Tlaleho ya mokgwa wa tokiso ha se risepe e felletseng e bolokehileng ya lelapa.
rows.ts: SANBI yi vika ku tirhisiwa eku swekeni kambe yi tlhela yi boxa swiphemu swa chefu ni ku vilela hi ku khomiwa hi chefu. Rhekhodo ya ku lulamisa a hi rhisipi leyi heleleke leyi hlayisekeke ya le kaya.
rows.ve: SANBI i vhiga u shumiswa kha u bika fhedzi i dovha ya bula zwivhumbi zwi re na mulimo na mbilaelo dza u vhaiswa nga mulimo. Muvhigo wa kulugisele a si resipi yo fhelelaho yo tsireledzeaho ya muṱa.

rows.english: Historical food use concerns the fatty berry coating, not a generic fresh sweet berry. No validated household extraction method, recovered food yield or storage life is established. Source coating/oil percentages are not assigned as processing conversion factors.
rows.zu: Ukusetshenziswa kokudla kwakudala kuphathelene nongqimba olunamafutha olumboze ijikijolo, hhayi noma yiliphi ijikijolo elimnandi elisha. Ayikho indlela eqinisekisiwe yokukhipha amafutha ekhaya, isivuno sokudla esitholakalayo noma ubude besikhathi sokugcina obuqinisekisiwe. Amaphesenti ongqimba noma kawoyela asemthonjeni awasetshenziswa njengezilinganiso zokuguqula ekucutshungulweni.
rows.st: Tshebediso ya dijo ya nako e fetileng e amana le lera la mafura le apesitseng monokotshwai, eseng monokotshwai ofe kapa ofe o foreshe o monate. Ha ho mokgwa o netefaditsweng wa ho ntsha mafura lapeng, chai ya dijo e fumanehang kapa nako ya poloko e tiisitsweng. Diperesente tsa lera kapa oli tsa mohlodi ha di abelwe ho ba dipalo tsa phetoho ha ho sebetswa.
rows.ts: Ku tirhisiwa ka khale tani hi swakudya ku khumba xifunengeto xa mafurha xa muhandzu lowutsongo, a hi muhandzu wun’wana ni wun’wana lowutsongo lowuntshwa wo tsokombela. Ku hava ndlela leyi tiyisisiweke yo humesa mafurha ekaya, ntshovelo wa swakudya lowu kumekaka kumbe nkarhi wo hlayisa lowu tiyisisiweke. Tipesente ta xifunengeto kumbe mafurha ta xihlovo a ti tirhisiwi tani hi swipimo swo cinca loko ku lulamisiwa.
rows.ve: U shumiswa ha ḓivhazwakale sa zwiḽiwa hu kwama luvhemba lwa mapfura lu funaho mutshelo muṱuku, hu si mutshelo muṱuku muṅwe na muṅwe muswa u ḓifhaho. A hu na nḓila yo khwaṱhisedzwaho ya u bvisa mapfura hayani, khaṋo ya zwiḽiwa i wanalaho kana vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha u vhulunga zwo khwaṱhisedzwaho. Phesenthe dza luvhemba kana mapfura dza tshiko a dzi avhelwi sa zwipimo zwa tshanduko kha u lugisa.

rows.english: This botanical description discusses pods that become brown at maturity. The separate harvesting section requires young, tender, green pods for food and supplies no calendar for that stage. March–April is retained as pod-development phenology, not a confirmed young-pod picking season or leaf calendar.
rows.zu: Le ncazelo yesayensi yezitshalo ikhuluma ngemidumba eba nsundu lapho ivuthwa. Ingxenye ehlukile yokuvuna idinga imidumba emincane, ethambile, eluhlaza njengokudla futhi ayinikezi ikhalenda laleso sigaba. Mashi–Ephreli kugcinwa njengezikhathi zokukhula kwemidumba, hhayi isikhathi esiqinisekisiwe sokuvuna imidumba emincane noma ikhalenda lamaqabunga.
rows.st: Tlhaloso ena ya dimela e bua ka mekotlana ya peo e bang sootho ha e butswa. Karolo e fapaneng ya kotulo e hloka mekotlana e menyane, e bonolo, e tala bakeng sa dijo mme ha e fane ka khalendara ya mokgahlelo oo. Hlakubele–Mmesa e bolokwa e le dinako tsa kgolo ya mekotlana ya peo, eseng sehla se netefaditsweng sa ho kotula e menyane kapa khalendara ya makgasi.
rows.ts: Nhlamuselo leyi ya swimila yi bula hi swiphotlo leswi vaka swa buraweni loko swi vupfa. Xiphemu xin’wana xa ku tshovela xi lava swiphotlo leswitsongo, swo olova, swa rihlaza swa swakudya naswona a xi nyiki khalendara ya xiyimo xexo. Nyenyankulu–Dzivamisoko swi hlayisiwa tani hi minkarhi ya ku kula ka swiphotlo, a hi nguva leyi tiyisisiweke yo tshovela swiphotlo leswitsongo kumbe khalendara ya matluka.
rows.ve: Ṱhalutshedzo iyi ya zwimela i amba nga mikumba ya mbeu ine ya vha ya buraweni musi i tshi vhibva. Tshipiḓa tsho fhambanaho tsha khaṋo tshi ṱoḓa mikumba miṱuku, yo leluwaho, midala sa zwiḽiwa nahone a tshi ṋei khaḽenda ya ḽeneḽo ḽiga. Ṱhafamuhwe–Lambamai zwi vhulungwa sa zwifhinga zwa u aluwa ha mikumba ya mbeu, hu si tshifhinga tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho tsha khaṋo ya mikumba miṱuku kana khaḽenda ya maṱari.

rows.english: The institutional species reference distinguishes fruiting forms and variable breeding systems. Ripe fruits are used as food; a black-fruited tree must not silently inherit this identity or the legal status of another Morus species.
rows.zu: Umthombo wesikhungo walolu hlobo lwesitshalo uhlukanisa izinhlobo ezithelayo nezindlela zokuzalana ezihlukahlukene. Izithelo ezivuthiwe zisetshenziswa njengokudla; isihlahla esithela ezimnyama akufanele sithathe lobu bunikazi noma isimo somthetho solunye uhlobo lwe-Morus ngaphandle kokucaciswa.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya setheo ya mofuta ona wa semela e kgetholla mefuta e behang le mekgwa e fapaneng ya ho ikatisa. Ditholwana tse butswitseng di sebediswa e le dijo; sefate se behang tse ntsho ha se a lokela ho nka boitsebiso bona kapa maemo a molao a mofuta o mong wa Morus ho sa hlaloswa.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xa nhlangano xa muxaka lowu wa ximilana xi hambanisa swivumbeko leswi tswalaka ni maendlelo yo hambana ya ku andza. Mihandzu leyi vupfeke yi tirhisiwa tani hi swakudya; nsinya lowu tswalaka mihandzu ya ntima a wu fanelanga ku teka vuxokoxoko bya muxaka lowu kumbe xiyimo xa nawu xa muxaka wun’wana wa Morus handle ko hlamuseriwa.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha tshiimiswa tsha lushaka ulu lwa tshimela tshi khethekanya zwivhumbeo zwi aṋwaho na maitele a u anda o fhambanaho. Mitshelo yo vhibvaho i shumiswa sa zwiḽiwa; muri u aṋwaho mitshelo mitswu a wo ngo tea u dzhia vhuvha uvhu kana vhuimo ha mulayo ha luṅwe lushaka lwa Morus hu sa ṱalutshedzwi.

rows.english: The museum lists M. nigra as cultivated in southern Africa and distinguishes naturalised Morus taxa. It gives no ripe-harvest months or quantified yield.
rows.zu: Imnyuziyamu ibala i-M. nigra njengelinywayo eningizimu ye-Afrika futhi ihlukanisa izinhlobo ze-Morus esezikhula ngaphandle kokutshalwa. Ayinikezi izinyanga zokuvuna okuvuthiwe noma isivuno esibaliwe.
rows.st: Musiamo o thathamisa M. nigra e le e lengwang borwa ba Afrika mme o kgetholla mefuta ya Morus e seng e mela ka boyona ka ntle ho temo. Ha o fane ka dikgwedi tsa kotulo ya tse butswitseng kapa chai e balilweng.
rows.ts: Myuziyamu yi xaxameta M. nigra tani hi leyi byariwaka edzongeni wa Afrika naswona yi hambanisa mixaka ya Morus leyi se yi tikuleleke handle ka ku byariwa. A yi nyiki tin’hweti to tshovela leyi vupfeke kumbe ntshovelo lowu pimiweke.
rows.ve: Muziumu u vhea M. nigra sa ine ya ṱavhiwa tshipembe ha Afrika nahone u khethekanya tshaka dza Morus dzine dza vho ḓimela hu sa ṱavhiwi. A a ṋei miṅwedzi ya khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho kana khaṋo yo vhalelwaho.

rows.english: Institutional management reference links dry roots to early fruit drop. It contains a non-local 15-year substantial-bearing statement; that is not a South African first-crop age and is not used as a forecast.
rows.zu: Umthombo wesikhungo wokuphatha uxhumanisa ukoma kwezimpande nokuwa kwezithelo ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Uqukethe isitatimende seminyaka engu-15 sokuqala ukukhiqiza kakhulu esingesona salapha; leyo akuyona iminyaka yesivuno sokuqala yaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ayisetshenziswa njengesibikezelo.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya tsamaiso ya setheo e amahanya metso e ommeng le ho wa ha ditholwana pele ho nako. E na le polelo e seng ya lehae ya dilemo tse 15 tsa ho beha haholo; tseo ha se dilemo tsa kotulo ya pele tsa Afrika Borwa mme ha e sebediswe e le ponelopele.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xa nhlangano xa nhlayiso xi hlanganisa timitsu leti omeke ni ku wa ka mihandzu ka ha ri ni nkarhi. Xi ni xivulwa lexi nga riki xa laha xa malembe ya 15 ya ku tswala ngopfu; wolawo a hi malembe ya ntshovelo wo sungula ya Afrika-Dzonga naswona a xi tirhisiwi tani hi mvhumbo.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha tshiimiswa tsha ndangulo tshi ṱumanya midzi yo omaho na u wa ha mitshelo hu tshee na tshifhinga. Tshi na fhungo ḽi si ḽa henefho ḽa miṅwaha ya 15 ya u aṋwa zwihulwane; iyo a si miṅwaha ya khaṋo ya u thoma ya Afrika Tshipembe nahone a ḽi shumiswi sa mbonelaphanḓa.

rows.english: KZN plantation reference per year: conservative 20–25 t/ha, average 25–30 t/ha, good 40+ t/ha. This is annual area production; it is not the weight of one bunch or a measured age-yield curve for three plants in a banana circle.
rows.zu: Umthombo wezinsimu zokuhweba ze-KZN ngonyaka: okulinganiselwe ngokucophelela 20–25 t/ha, okuvamile 25–30 t/ha, okuhle 40+ t/ha. Lokhu ukukhiqiza kwendawo ngonyaka; akusona isisindo sesixha esisodwa noma ijika lesivuno ngokweminyaka elilinganisiwe lezitshalo ezintathu kumbuthano kabhanana.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya masimo a kgwebo a KZN ka selemo: tekanyo e hlokolosi 20–25 t/ha, karolelano 25–30 t/ha, e ntle 40+ t/ha. Ena ke tlhahiso ya sebaka ka selemo; ha se boima ba lesihla le le leng kapa mola o lekantsweng wa chai ka dilemo wa dimela tse tharo sedikadikweng sa banana.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xa masimu ya bindzu ya KZN hi lembe: mpimo wo tivonela 20–25 t/ha, avhareji 25–30 t/ha, lowunene 40+ t/ha. Lexi i vuhumelerisi bya ndhawu hi lembe; a hi ntiko wa xichocho xin’we kumbe layini leyi pimiweke ya ntshovelo hi malembe ya swimila swinharhu eka xirhendzevutana xa banana.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha masimu a bindu a KZN nga ṅwaha: mupimo wa u ṱhogomela 20–25 t/ha, vhukati 25–30 t/ha, wavhuḓi 40+ t/ha. Uhu ndi vhubveledzi ha fhethu nga ṅwaha; a si tshileme tsha tshoko tshithihi kana mutevhe wo pimwaho wa khaṋo nga miṅwaha wa zwimela zwiraru kha tshitendeledzi tsha banana.

rows.english: The KZN guide gives 13–20 months for both the first planting-to-harvest cycle and subsequent harvest-to-harvest cycles. It lists different commercial densities for Williams, Grand Nain and Chinese Cavendish. A banana circle counts as three planted bananas here; replacement followers are stages of those mats, not extra mapped trees or guaranteed year-round supply.
rows.zu: Umhlahlandlela we-KZN unikeza izinyanga ezingu-13–20 kukho kokubili umjikelezo wokuqala wokutshala kuze kube ukuvuna nemijikelezo elandelayo yokuvuna kuya ekuvuneni. Ubala ukuminyana okuhlukene kwezohwebo kwe-Williams, Grand Nain ne-Chinese Cavendish. Umbuthano kabhanana ubalwa njengezitshalo ezintathu zikabhanana ezitshaliwe lapha; amahlumela alandelayo athatha indawo ayizigaba zalezo ziqu ezihlangene, akuzona izihlahla ezengeziwe ebalazweni noma isiqinisekiso sokudla unyaka wonke.
rows.st: Tataiso ya KZN e fana ka dikgwedi tse 13–20 bakeng sa potoloho ya pele ya ho jala ho fihlela kotulo le dipotoloho tse latelang tsa kotulo ho isa kotulong. E thathamisa dipalo tse fapaneng tsa temo ya kgwebo ka sebaka tsa Williams, Grand Nain le Chinese Cavendish. Sedikadikwe sa banana se balwa e le dimela tse tharo tsa banana tse jetsweng mona; mahlomela a latelang a nkang sebaka ke mekgahlelo ya dihlopha tseo tsa dikutu, eseng difate tse eketsehileng mmapeng kapa phepelo e tiisitsweng selemo kaofela.
rows.ts: Nkongomiso wa KZN wu nyika tin’hweti ta 13–20 eka xirhendzevutana xo sungula xo byala ku fika eku tshoveleni ni swirhendzevutana leswi landzelaka swa ntshovelo ku fika eka ntshovelo. Wu xaxameta nhlayo yo hambana ya swimila endhawini ya bindzu ya Williams, Grand Nain ni Chinese Cavendish. Xirhendzevutana xa banana xi hlayiwa tani hi mabanana manharhu lama byariweke laha; mahluke lama landzelaka lama sivelaka ya khale i swiyimo swa swigwada swoleswo swa swimila, a hi misinya yin’wana eka mepe kumbe mphakelo lowu tiyisisiweke lembe hinkwaro.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya KZN i ṋea miṅwedzi ya 13–20 kha mutevhe wa u thoma wa u ṱavha u swika kha u kaṋa na kha mitevhe i tevhelaho ya u kaṋa u swika kha u kaṋa. I vhea tshivhalo tsho fhambanaho tsha zwimela fhethu kha vhulimi ha bindu ha Williams, Grand Nain na Chinese Cavendish. Tshitendeledzi tsha banana tshi vhalwa sa zwimela zwiraru zwa banana zwo ṱavhiwaho afha; mihlavhi i tevhelaho ine ya dzhia vhuimo ha ya kale ndi maga a zwenezwo zwigwada zwa midzi, a si miṅwe miri kha mapa kana mphakelo wo khwaṱhisedzwaho ṅwaha woṱhe.

rows.english: Wild olive is distinct from a named commercial olive cultivar. March–July describes fruit following flowers; no exact ripe-picking start/end is established.
rows.zu: I-Wild olive ihlukile ohlotsheni lwe-olive lokuhweba olunegama. Mashi–Julayi kuchaza izithelo ezilandela izimbali; akukasungulwa ukuqala nokuphela okuqondile kokuvuna okuvuthiwe.
rows.st: Wild olive e fapane le mofuta wa olive wa kgwebo o nang le lebitso. Hlakubele–Phupu e hlalosa ditholwana tse latelang dipalesa; qalo le pheletso tse nepahetseng tsa kotulo ya tse butswitseng ha di a tiiswa.
rows.ts: Wild olive yi hambanile ni muxaka wa olive wa bindzu lowu nga ni vito. Nyenyankulu–Mawuwani swi hlamusela mihandzu leyi landzelaka swiluva; ku sungula ni ku hela hi ku kongoma ka ku tshovela leyi vupfeke a swi tiyisisiwanga.
rows.ve: Wild olive yo fhambana na lushaka lwa olive lwa bindu lu re na dzina. Ṱhafamuhwe–Fulwana zwi ṱalutshedza mitshelo i tevhelaho maluvha; u thoma na u fhela ho teaho ha khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho a zwo ngo khwaṱhisedzwa.

rows.english: Frantoio is described as an oil and cross-pollen candidate. Mission suits black table olives and oil; Kalamata black table, Manzanilla and Barouni green table. Climate fit and pollen needs depend on cultivar.
rows.zu: I-Frantoio ichazwa njengohlobo olungakhiqiza uwoyela nolungaba ngumlingani wempova. I-Mission ifanele ama-olive amnyama asetafuleni nowoyela; i-Kalamata ifanele amnyama asetafuleni, i-Manzanilla ne-Barouni aluhlaza asetafuleni. Ukufaneleka kwesimo sezulu nezidingo zempova kuncike ohlotsheni olutshalwayo.
rows.st: Frantoio e hlaloswa e le kgetho ya oli le ya ho fana ka peo ya palesa pakeng tsa mefuta. Mission e loketse olive tse ntsho tsa tafoleng le oli; Kalamata tse ntsho tsa tafoleng, Manzanilla le Barouni tse tala tsa tafoleng. Ho tshwaneleha ha tlelaemete le ditlhoko tsa peo ya dipalesa di itshetlehile ka mofuta o lengwang.
rows.ts: Frantoio yi hlamuseriwa tani hi muxaka lowu nga tirhisiwaka eka mafurha ni ku nyika pholeni eka wun’wana. Mission yi faneleka eka olive ta ntima ta le tafuleni ni mafurha; Kalamata eka ta ntima ta le tafuleni, Manzanilla ni Barouni eka ta rihlaza ta le tafuleni. Ku faneleka ka maxelo ni swilaveko swa pholeni swi ya hi muxaka lowu byariwaka.
rows.ve: Frantoio i ṱalutshedzwa sa lushaka lune lwa nga shumiswa kha mapfura na u ṋea muvhumbisi kha luṅwe. Mission i tea olive ntswu dza ṱafulani na mapfura; Kalamata ntswu dza ṱafulani, Manzanilla na Barouni dala dza ṱafulani. U tea ha kilima na ṱhoḓea dza muvhumbisi zwi ḓisendeka nga lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho.

rows.english: This is a historical one-hectare financial model; it does not provide matched per-tree kg or a measured biological maturity curve. No financial values or pesticide recipes are copied.
rows.zu: Lokhu kuyimodeli yezimali yehektha elilodwa yakudala; ayinikezi ama-kg esihlahla ngasinye ahambisana nayo noma ijika elilinganisiwe lokukhula nokuvuthwa kwesitshalo. Azikho izimali noma izindlela zokuxuba izibulala-zinambuzane ezikopishiwe.
rows.st: Ena ke mohlala wa ditjhelete wa hektare e le nngwe wa nako e fetileng; ha o fane ka kg tsa sefate ka seng tse tsamaellanang le wona kapa mola o lekantsweng wa ho hola le ho butswa ha semela. Ha ho dipalo tsa ditjhelete kapa diresepe tsa dibolayadikokonyana tse kopitswang.
rows.ts: Lexi i xivumbeko xa timali xa hektara yin’we xa khale; a xi nyiki kg ta nsinya wun’wana ni wun’wana leti fambelanaka na xona kumbe layini leyi pimiweke ya ku kula ka ximilana ku fika eku vupfeni. Ku hava tinhlayo ta timali kumbe tirhisipi ta swidlaya-switsotswana leti kopiwaka.
rows.ve: Iyi ndi modeḽe ya masheleni ya hekithara nthihi ya ḓivhazwakale; a i ṋei kg dza muri muṅwe na muṅwe dzi tendelanaho nayo kana mutevhe wo pimwaho wa u aluwa na u vhibva ha tshimela. A hu na mbalo dza masheleni kana resipi dza zwivhulahi zwa zwikhokhonono dzo kopiwaho.

rows.english: Food is the ripe fruit. Main flowering in autumn/winter and fruit shortly afterwards do not establish named picking months.
rows.zu: Ukudla yisithelo esivuthiwe. Ukuqhakaza kakhulu ekwindla/ebusika nezithelo ezilandela masinyane akubeki izinyanga zokuvuna ezishiwo ngamagama.
rows.st: Sejo ke tholwana e butswitseng. Ho thunya ho hoholo nakong ya hwetla/mariha le ditholwana tse hlahang kapele kamora moo ha ho behe dikgwedi tse boletsweng tsa kotulo.
rows.ts: Swakudya i muhandzu lowu vupfeke. Ku rhumbuka lokukulu hi xixikana/vuxika ni mihandzu leyi landzelaka hi ku hatlisa a swi veki tin’hweti to tshovela leti nga ni mavito.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa ndi mutshelo wo vhibvaho. U ṱuma maluvha nga vhunzhi nga tshifhefho/vhuria na mitshelo i tevhelaho nga u ṱavhanya a zwi vhei miṅwedzi yo bulwaho ya khaṋo.

rows.english: SANBI describes green fruits that later split to expose edible red flesh. Its December–July fruit-production interval does not state when the fruit is ripe. Retain this as a general southern African phenology reference; local ripe picking months remain unknown.
rows.zu: I-SANBI ichaza izithelo eziluhlaza kamuva eziqhekeka ziveze inyama ebomvu edliwayo. Isikhathi sayo sokukhiqiza izithelo sika-Disemba–Julayi asisho ukuthi izithelo zivuthwa nini. Gcina lokhu njengomthombo ojwayelekile wezikhathi zezigaba zokukhula eningizimu ye-Afrika; izinyanga zendawo zokuvuna okuvuthiwe zisalokhu zingaziwa.
rows.st: SANBI e hlalosa ditholwana tse tala tse petsohang hamorao ho pepesa nama e kgubedu e jewang. Nako ya yona ya tlhahiso ya ditholwana ya Tshitwe–Phupu ha e bolele hore ditholwana di butswa neng. Boloka sena e le tshupiso e akaretsang ya dinako tsa mekgahlelo ya kgolo borwa ba Afrika; dikgwedi tsa lehae tsa kotulo ya tse butswitseng di ntse di sa tsejwe.
rows.ts: SANBI yi hlamusela mihandzu ya rihlaza leyi endzhaku yi pandzekaka yi humesa nyama yo tshwuka leyi dyiwaka. Nkarhi wa yona wa ku humesa mihandzu wa N'wendzamhala–Mawuwani a wu vuli leswaku mihandzu yi vupfa rini. Hlayisa leswi tani hi xihlovo xa ntolovelo xa minkarhi ya swiyimo swa ku kula edzongeni wa Afrika; tin’hweti ta laha kaya to tshovela leyi vupfeke ta ha ri leti nga tivekiki.
rows.ve: SANBI i ṱalutshedza mitshelo midala ine nga murahu ya vulea ya sumbedza ṋama tswuku i ḽiwaho. Tshifhinga tshayo tsha u bveledza mitshelo tsha Nyendavhusiku–Fulwana a tshi buli uri mitshelo i vhibva lini. Vhulungani izwi sa tshiko tsho ḓoweleaho tsha zwifhinga zwa maga a u aluwa tshipembe ha Afrika; miṅwedzi ya henefho ya khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho i kha ḓi vha i sa ḓivhei.

rows.english: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
rows.zu: I-Hass ku-Duke 7, ekuqaleni izihlahla ezingu-200 trees/ha e-Bruyns Hill (iqembu lesimo sezulu nokuphila lase-Natal Midlands elingu-2), ngokunisela nokondla kakhulu. Iminyaka 3: 10,000 kg/ha; iminyaka 6: 20,000 kg/ha; isilinganiso esimaphakathi esingaqhubeka cishe 22,500 kg/ha. Ukuminyana kwezihlahla kuleso silingo kuvumela okulingana no-50 kg/tree eminyakeni engu-3 no-100 kg/tree eminyakeni engu-6; awukho umthombo weminyaka ngayinye ephakathi. Lezi zinkomba zensimu yezihlahla zincike ezinsizeni ezinhle, isimo sezulu esifanayo nokuphathwa kwensimu ngesikhathi esifanele, kuhlanganise nokulawula i-Phytophthora nokunciphisa (thinning); ungagcwalisi ngokuzenzakalela amanani epulazi.
rows.st: Hass hodima Duke 7, qalong difate tse 200 trees/ha Bruyns Hill (sehlopha sa tlelaemete le bophelo sa Natal Midlands sa 2), ka nosetso le phepo e matla. Dilemo tse 3: 10,000 kg/ha; dilemo tse 6: 20,000 kg/ha; karolelano e ka tswelang pele hoo e ka bang 22,500 kg/ha. Palo ya difate ka sebaka tekong yona eo e dumella tekano ya 50 kg/tree dilemong tse 3 le 100 kg/tree dilemong tse 6; ha ho tshupiso ya dilemo ka ding tse pakeng. Ditshupiso tsena tsa tshimo ya difate di itshetlehile ka disebediswa tse ntle, tlelaemete e tshwanang le tsamaiso ya tshimo ka nako, ho akarelletsa taolo ya Phytophthora le phokotso (thinning); o se tlatse dipalo tsa polasi ka boiketsetso.
rows.ts: Hass eka Duke 7, eku sunguleni misinya ya 200 trees/ha eBruyns Hill (ntlawa wa maxelo ni swilo leswi hanyaka wa Natal Midlands wa 2), hi ku cheleta ni ku nyika swakudya ngopfu. Malembe ya 3: 10,000 kg/ha; malembe ya 6: 20,000 kg/ha; avhareji leyi nga yaka mahlweni kwalomu ka 22,500 kg/ha. Nhlayo ya misinya endhawini eka ndzingo wolowo yi pfumelela leswi ringanaka na 50 kg/tree eka malembe ya 3 ni 100 kg/tree eka malembe ya 6; ku hava xihlovo xa lembe rin’wana ni rin’wana leri nga le xikarhini. Swipimo leswi swa nsimu ya misinya swi ya hi switirhisiwa leswinene, maxelo lama fanaka ni nhlayiso wa nsimu hi nkarhi, ku katsa ku lawula Phytophthora ni ku hunguta (thinning); u nga tati tinhlayo ta purasi hi ku tisungulela.
rows.ve: Hass kha Duke 7, mathomoni miri ya 200 trees/ha ngei Bruyns Hill (tshigwada tsha kilima na zwithu zwi tshilaho tsha Natal Midlands tsha 2), hu na u sheledza na u ṋea pfushi nga maanḓa. Miṅwaha ya 3: 10,000 kg/ha; miṅwaha ya 6: 20,000 kg/ha; vhukati vhune ha nga bvela phanḓa hu ṱoḓaho u vha 22,500 kg/ha. Tshivhalo tsha miri fhethu kha ndingo yeneyo tshi tendela zwi linganaho na 50 kg/tree kha miṅwaha ya 3 na 100 kg/tree kha miṅwaha ya 6; a hu na tshiko tsha ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe wa vhukati. Zwipimo izwi zwa tsimu ya miri zwi ḓisendeka nga zwishumiswa zwavhuḓi, kilima i fanaho na ndangulo ya tsimu nga tshifhinga, zwi tshi katela u langa Phytophthora na u fhungudza (thinning); ni songo ḓadza mbalo dza bulasi nga u ḓiita.

rows.english: Table is fruit-set-to-maturation duration, not months of ripe harvest. Its separate table lists July–August flowering. Neither becomes a food-availability bar.
rows.zu: Itafula liyisikhathi sokusunguleka kwesithelo kuze kube ukuvuthwa, akuzona izinyanga zokuvuna okuvuthiwe. Itafula lalo elihlukile libala ukuqhakaza ngo-Julayi–Agasti. Akukho kulokhu okuba yibha yokutholakala kokudla.
rows.st: Tafole e fana ka nako ho tloha ha tholwana e qala ho theha ho fihlela e butswa, eseng dikgwedi tsa kotulo ya tse butswitseng. Tafole e fapaneng ya yona e thathamisa ho thunya ka Phupu–Phata. Ha ho le e nngwe e fetohang mola wa ho fumaneha ha dijo.
rows.ts: Tafula i nkarhi wa ku sungula ku vumbeka ka muhandzu ku fika eku vupfeni, a hi tin’hweti to tshovela leyi vupfeke. Tafula ra rona rin’wana ri xaxameta ku rhumbuka hi Mawuwani–Mhawuri. Ku hava lexi hundzukaka bara ya ku kumeka ka swakudya.
rows.ve: Thebuḽu ndi vhulapfu ha tshifhinga u bva kha u thoma u vhumbea ha mutshelo u swika kha u vhibva, a si miṅwedzi ya khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho. Thebuḽu yayo yo fhambanaho i vhea u ṱuma maluvha nga Fulwana–Ṱhangule. A hu na tshithihi tshine tsha vha bara ya u wanala ha zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: Broad hemispheric context, not a measured cultivar/site calendar. Kept outside the structured local harvest windows.
rows.zu: Umongo obanzi wengxenye yomhlaba, akulona ikhalenda elilinganisiwe lohlobo olutshalwayo noma lendawo. Kugcinwa ngaphandle kwezikhathi zendawo zokuvuna ezibekwe ohlelweni.
rows.st: Ke maemo a akaretsang a halofo ya lefatshe, eseng khalendara e lekantsweng ya mofuta o lengwang kapa sebaka. E bolokwa ka ntle ho dinako tsa lehae tsa kotulo tse hlophisitsweng.
rows.ts: Xiyimo xo anama xa hafu ya misava, a hi khalendara leyi pimiweke ya muxaka lowu byariwaka kumbe ndhawu. Xi hlayisiwa ehandle ka minkarhi ya ku tshovela ya laha kaya leyi hleriweke.
rows.ve: Nyimele yo ṱanḓavhuwaho ya hafu ya ḽifhasi, a si khaḽenda yo pimwaho ya lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho kana fhethu. I vhulungwa nnḓa ha zwifhinga zwa khaṋo ya henefho zwo dzudzanywaho.

rows.english: 2022 trial at Kleinplasie near Hermon concerns Medjool. Abstract treatment dates label ripening stages inconsistently; no harvest months are inferred. Full university handle returned HTTP 403 during checking.
rows.zu: Isilingo sango-2022 e-Kleinplasie eduze kwe-Hermon siphathelene ne-Medjool. Izinsuku zokwelashwa ezisesifinyezweni zibiza izigaba zokuvuthwa ngendlela engahambisani; azikho izinyanga zokuvuna ezicatshangwayo. Isixhumanisi serekhodi eliphelele lenyuvesi sabuyisa i-HTTP 403 ngesikhathi sihlolwa.
rows.st: Teko ya 2022 Kleinplasie pela Hermon e amana le Medjool. Matsatsi a mekgwa ya kalafo a kgutsufatsong a bitsa mekgahlelo ya ho butswa ka ditsela tse sa dumellaneng; ha ho dikgwedi tsa kotulo tse hakanywang. Sehokelo sa rekoto e felletseng ya yunivesithi se kgutlisitse HTTP 403 nakong ya ho hlahloba.
rows.ts: Ndzingo wa 2022 eKleinplasie ekusuhi na Hermon wu khumba Medjool. Masiku ya maendlelo eka nkatsakanyo ma thya swiyimo swa ku vupfa hi tindlela leti nga fambelaniki; ku hava tin’hweti to tshovela leti ringanyetiwaka. Xihlanganisi xa rhekhodo leyi heleleke ya yunivhesiti xi vuyise HTTP 403 loko ku kambisisiwa.
rows.ve: Ndingo ya 2022 ngei Kleinplasie tsini na Hermon i kwama Medjool. Maḓuvha a maitele kha manweledzo a vhidza maga a u vhibva nga nḓila dzi sa tendelani; a hu na miṅwedzi ya khaṋo ine ya humbulelwa. Ḽiṅwalwa ḽa rekhodo yo fhelelaho ya yunivesithi ḽo vhuisa HTTP 403 musi hu tshi khou ṱolwa.

rows.english: The same questionnaire confirms the nuts are grown on the producer's farm. Cultivar names are reproduced as written; spelling is not a taxonomy or catalogue change.
rows.zu: Lona lolo hlu lwemibuzo luqinisekisa ukuthi amantongomane atshalwa epulazini lomkhiqizi. Amagama ezinhlobo ezitshalwayo abhalwa njengoba esemthonjeni; indlela apelwa ngayo ayilushintsho lokuhlukaniswa kwezitshalo ngokwesayensi noma lwekhathalogi.
rows.st: Lenane lona leo la dipotso le netefatsa hore linate di lengwa polasing ya mohlahisi. Mabitso a mefuta e lengwang a ngolwa kamoo a ngotsweng kateng; mopeleto ha se phetoho ya tlhophiso ya dimela ka saense kapa ya khathaloko.
rows.ts: Nxaxamelo wolowo wa swivutiso wu tiyisisa leswaku timanga ti byariwa epurasini ra muhumelerisi. Mavito ya mixaka leyi byariwaka ma tsariwa hi laha ma tsariweke ha kona; mapeletelo a hi ku cinca ka ku hambanisa mixaka hi sayense kumbe ka khathalogo.
rows.ve: Mutevhe wonoyo wa mbudziso u khwaṱhisedza uri nḓuhu dzi ṱavhiwa kha bulasi ya mubveledzi. Madzina a tshaka dzi ṱavhiwaho a ṅwalwa nga nḓila ye a ṅwalwa ngayo; mapeleṱe a si tshanduko ya u khethekanya zwimela nga saintsi kana ya khathaḽogo.

rows.english: An expectation for the newly established Platberg project, not a measured universal age curve. Its planted cultivars are Shufra, Ariyeh and Sirora; irrigated Karoo context retained.
rows.zu: Lokhu okulindelwe kuphrojekthi yase-Platberg esanda kusungulwa, akulona ijika leminyaka elilinganisiwe elisebenza yonke indawo. Izinhlobo zayo ezitshaliwe yi-Shufra, Ariyeh ne-Sirora; umongo wase-Karoo oniselwayo uyagcinwa.
rows.st: Ke tebello ya projeke ya Platberg e sa tswa thehwa, eseng mola wa dilemo o lekantsweng o sebetsang dibakeng tsohle. Mefuta ya yona e jetsweng ke Shufra, Ariyeh le Sirora; maemo a Karoo e nosetswang a bolokwa.
rows.ts: Lexi xi languteriwe eka phurojeke ya Platberg leyi ya ha ku sungulaka, a hi layini ya malembe leyi pimiweke leyi tirhaka hinkwako. Mixaka ya yona leyi byariweke i Shufra, Ariyeh ni Sirora; xiyimo xa Karoo leyi cheletiwaka xa hlayisiwa.
rows.ve: Izwi ndi zwo lavhelelwaho kha thandela ya Platberg ye ya tou simuwa, a si mutevhe wa miṅwaha wo pimwaho une wa tea fhethu hoṱhe. Tshaka dzayo dzo ṱavhiwaho ndi Shufra, Ariyeh na Sirora; nyimele ya Karoo i sheledzwaho i a vhulungwa.

rows.english: The food is the tart leaf; flowers do not define leaf picking months.
rows.zu: Ukudla yiqabunga elimuncu; izimbali azibeki izinyanga zokuvuna amaqabunga.
rows.st: Sejo ke lekgasi le bodila; dipalesa ha di behe dikgwedi tsa ho kotula makgasi.
rows.ts: Swakudya i tluka ro dzunga; swiluva a swi veki tin’hweti to tshovela matluka.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa ndi ṱari ḽi vhavhaho; maluvha a a vhei miṅwedzi ya khaṋo ya maṱari.

rows.english: The study analyses processed spekboom leaves. Its laboratory method and composition are not a farm harvest rate, storage life or household food-safety recipe.
rows.zu: Ucwaningo luhlaziya amaqabunga e-spekboom acutshunguliwe. Indlela yalo yaselabhorethri nokwakheka kwawo akulona izinga lokuvuna epulazini, ubude besikhathi sokugcina noma iresiphi yokuphepha kokudla kwasekhaya.
rows.st: Patlisiso e sekaseka makgasi a spekboom a sebeditsweng. Mokgwa wa yona wa laboratoring le sebopeho sa makgasi ha se lebelo la kotulo ya polasi, nako ya poloko kapa risepe ya polokeho ya dijo tsa lelapa.
rows.ts: Ndzavisiso wu kambisisa matluka ya spekboom lama lulamisiweke. Ndlela ya wona ya elaborethri ni leswi matluka ma vumbiweke ha swona a hi mpimo wa ntshovelo wa purasi, nkarhi wo hlayisa kumbe rhisipi ya vuhlayiseki bya swakudya swa le kaya.
rows.ve: Ṱhoḓisiso i sedzulusa maṱari a spekboom o lugiswaho. Nḓila yayo ya ḽaborothiri na zwivhumbi zwa maṱari a si tshikalo tsha khaṋo ya bulasi, vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha u vhulunga kana resipi ya tsireledzo ya zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa.

rows.english: Solitaire is listed as self-compatible. Its chilling units are named-cultivar requirements and are not a numeric range for every apricot.
rows.zu: I-Solitaire ibhalwe njengaleyo eyamukela impova yayo. Amayunithi ayo amakhaza ayizidingo zohlobo oluthile olunegama, akusona isikhawu sezinombolo esisebenza kuwo wonke ama-apricot.
rows.st: Solitaire e thathamisitswe e le e dumellanang le peo ya palesa ya yona. Diyuniti tsa yona tsa serame ke ditlhoko tsa mofuta o itseng o nang le lebitso mme ha se moedi wa dipalo bakeng sa apricot tsohle.
rows.ts: Solitaire yi xaxametiwile tani hi leyi amukelaka pholeni ya yona. Tiyuniti ta yona ta ku titimela i swilaveko swa muxaka lowu nga ni vito naswona a hi ndzhawu ya tinhlayo ya apricot yin’wana ni yin’wana.
rows.ve: Solitaire yo vhewa sa ine ya ṱanganedza muvhumbisi wayo. Yuniti dzayo dza murotholo ndi ṱhoḓea dza lushaka lu re na dzina nahone a si zwikalo zwa mbalo zwa apricot iṅwe na iṅwe.

rows.english: The field experiment used managed organic orchards and found trade-offs in mulch effects; it does not justify a universal yield improvement from mulch.
rows.zu: Isilingo sasensimini sasebenzisa izinsimu zezihlahla eziphathwayo ze-organic futhi sathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nokulahlekelwa okuthile emiphumeleni yesembozo senhlabathi; asiqinisekisi ukuthi isembozo sithuthukisa isivuno kuyo yonke indawo.
rows.st: Teko ya tshimong e sebedisitse masimo a difate a organic a laolwang mme ya fumana melemo le ditahlehelo diphellong tsa ho kwahela mobu; ha e fane ka lebaka la hore ho kwahela mobu ho ntlafatsa chai dibakeng tsohle.
rows.ts: Ndzingo wa le nsin’weni wu tirhise masimu ya misinya ya organic lama lawuriwaka naswona wu kume ku cincana ka leswinene ni leswi lahlekaka eka mbuyelo wa ku funengeta misava; a wu tiyisisi ku antswisiwa ka ntshovelo hi ku funengeta eka tindhawu hinkwato.
rows.ve: Ndingo ya tsimuni yo shumisa masimu a miri a organic a langwaho nahone ya wana mbuelo na zwine zwa xelela kha mvelelo dza u fukedza mavu; a i tikedzi uri u fukedza mavu hu engedza khaṋo fhethu hoṱhe.

rows.english: The guide reports 4–6 kg/tree in year 6 and warns that yields are difficult to predict because of pollination and fruit set. The separate good result at year 8–9 is 9 t/ha. Do not connect them into a made-up growth curve or convert the later hectare result to arbitrary tree spacing.
rows.zu: Umhlahlandlela ubika 4–6 kg/tree ngonyaka 6 futhi uxwayisa ukuthi isivuno sinzima ukusibikezela ngenxa yokumpova nokusunguleka kwezithelo. Umphumela ohlukile omuhle ngonyaka 8–9 ungu-9 t/ha. Ungakuxhumanisi kube ijika lokukhula eliqanjiwe noma uguqule umphumela wehektha wakamuva usebenzisa izikhala zezihlahla oziqagelile.
rows.st: Tataiso e tlaleha 4–6 kg/tree selemong sa 6 mme e lemosa hore chai e thata ho e bolela esale pele ka lebaka la ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa le ho theha ha ditholwana. Sephetho se fapaneng se setle selemong sa 8–9 ke 9 t/ha. O se di hokahanye ho etsa mola wa kgolo o iqapetsweng kapa wa fetola sephetho sa hektare sa hamorao ka dikgeo tsa difate tse hakantsweng feela.
rows.ts: Nkongomiso wu vika 4–6 kg/tree eka lembe ra 6 naswona wu tsundzuxa leswaku mintshovelo ya tika ku yi vhumbha hikokwalaho ka pholeni ni ku vumbeka ka mihandzu. Mbuyelo wun’wana lowunene eka lembe ra 8–9 i 9 t/ha. U nga swi hlanganisi ku va layini ya ku kula leyi tumbuluxiweke kumbe u cinca mbuyelo wa hektara wa le ndzhaku hi ku tirhisa mpfhuka wa misinya lowu u wu hlawuleke handle ka xihlovo.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo i vhiga 4–6 kg/tree kha ṅwaha wa 6 nahone i tsivhudza uri khaṋo dzi a konḓa u dzi bvumba nga ṅwambo wa muvhumbisi na u vhumbea ha mitshelo. Mvelelo iṅwe yavhuḓi kha ṅwaha wa 8–9 ndi 9 t/ha. Ni songo zwi ṱumanya uri zwi vhe mutevhe wa u aluwa wo itwaho nga khumbulelo kana na shandula mvelelo ya hekithara ya nga murahu nga u shumisa zwikhala zwa miri zwe na ḓinangela hu si na tshiko.

rows.english: Conventional commercial cherry reference: more than 1,000 Positive Utah Chill Units, not 1,000 chill hours. Low-chill candidates need their own verified requirements. Most cultivars need compatible cross-pollination; the named self-fertile choices differ. The September flowering reference is not a picking-month array.
rows.zu: Umthombo we-cherry yokuhweba evamile: ngaphezu kuka-1,000 Positive Utah Chill Units, hhayi amahora amakhaza angu-1,000. Izinhlobo ezingadingi amakhaza amaningi zidinga izidingo zazo eziqinisekisiwe. Izinhlobo eziningi zidinga impova ehambisanayo evela kolunye uhlobo; ezishiwo ngegama ezikwamukela impova yazo ziyahlukahluka. Umthombo wokuqhakaza ngo-Septhemba awulona uhlu lwezinyanga zokuvuna.
rows.st: Tshupiso ya cherry ya kgwebo e tlwaelehileng: ho feta 1,000 Positive Utah Chill Units, eseng dihora tsa serame tse 1,000. Mefuta e hlokang serame se fokolang e hloka ditlhoko tsa yona tse netefaditsweng. Mefuta e mengata e hloka peo ya dipalesa e dumellanang e tswang mofuteng o mong; dikgetho tse boletsweng ka mabitso tse ikemelang ka peo ya dipalesa di fapane. Tshupiso ya ho thunya ka Leotshe ha se lenane la dikgwedi tsa kotulo.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xa cherry ya bindzu ya ntolovelo: ku hundza 1,000 Positive Utah Chill Units, a hi tiawara ta ku titimela ta 1,000. Mixaka leyi lavaka ku titimela kutsongo yi lava swilaveko swa yona leswi tiyisisiweke. Mixaka yo tala yi lava pholeni leyi fambelanaka leyi humaka eka muxaka wun’wana; mixaka leyi boxiweke hi mavito leyi tswalaka hi pholeni ya yona ya hambana. Xihlovo xa ku rhumbuka hi Ndzhati a hi nxaxamelo wa tin’hweti to tshovela.
rows.ve: Tshiko tsha cherry ya bindu yo ḓoweleaho: u fhira 1,000 Positive Utah Chill Units, hu si awara dza murotholo dza 1,000. Tshaka dzi ṱoḓaho murotholo muṱuku dzi ṱoḓa ṱhoḓea dzadzo dzo khwaṱhisedzwaho. Tshaka nnzhi dzi ṱoḓa muvhumbisi u tendelanaho u bvaho kha luṅwe lushaka; tshaka dzo bulwaho nga madzina dzi aṋwaho nga muvhumbisi wadzo dzi a fhambana. Tshiko tsha u ṱuma maluvha nga Khubvumedzi a si mutevhe wa miṅwedzi ya khaṋo.

rows.english: Ceres growers reported the start of the 2025 cherry harvest in late October, seven to ten days earlier than the prior year. This is an observed season in a named region, not a fixed future duration, KZN calendar or all-variety season.
rows.zu: Abalimi base-Ceres babika ukuqala kokuvuna kwe-cherry kwango-2025 ngasekupheleni kuka-Okthoba, izinsuku eziyisikhombisa kuya kweziyishumi ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuqala sangonyaka owandulele. Lesi yisikhathi esibonwe esifundeni esiqanjwe ngegama, akusona isikhathi esizayo esingashintshi, ikhalenda le-KZN noma isikhathi sazo zonke izinhlobo.
rows.st: Balemi ba Ceres ba tlalehile qalo ya kotulo ya cherry ya 2025 qetellong ya Mphalane, matsatsi a supileng ho isa ho a leshome pele ho nako ya qalo ya selemong se fetileng. Sena ke sehla se bonweng lebatoweng le boletsweng ka lebitso, eseng nako e tsitsitseng ya bokamoso, khalendara ya KZN kapa sehla sa mefuta yohle.
rows.ts: Varimi va Ceres va vike ku sungula ka ntshovelo wa cherry wa 2025 eku heleni ka Nhlangula, masiku ya nkombo ku fika eka khume ku hatlisa ku hundza nkarhi wa ku sungula eka lembe leri hundzeke. Leyi i nguva leyi voniweke eka xifundzha lexi boxiweke hi vito, a hi nkarhi lowu tiyeke wa le mahlweni, khalendara ya KZN kumbe nguva ya mixaka hinkwayo.
rows.ve: Vhalimi vha Ceres vho vhiga u thoma ha khaṋo ya cherry ya 2025 mafheloni a Tshimedzi, maḓuvha a sumbe u swika kha a fumi nga phanḓa ha tshifhinga tsha u thoma tsha ṅwaha wo fhiraho. Itshi ndi tshifhinga tsho vhonwaho kha dzingu ḽo bulwaho nga dzina, a si vhulapfu ha tshifhinga vhu sa shanduki ha tshifhinga tshi ḓaho, khaḽenda ya KZN kana tshifhinga tsha tshaka dzoṱhe.

rows.english: Texas Mission is classified high chill and names Nonpareil as pollinator. Its 5 kg/tree production entry does not state tree age, management, trial region or whether weight is kernel or in-shell; it is not a mature annual food forecast.
rows.zu: I-Texas Mission ihlukaniswe njengedinga amakhaza amaningi futhi ibiza i-Nonpareil njengomnikezi wempova. Umbhalo wayo wokukhiqiza ongu-5 kg/tree awusho iminyaka yesihlahla, indlela yokuphatha, isifunda sesilingo noma ukuthi isisindo singesenhlamvu noma sinamagobolondo; akusona isibikezelo sokudla sonyaka sesihlahla esikhulile.
rows.st: Texas Mission e behilwe sehlopheng se hlokang serame se seholo mme e re Nonpareil ke mofani wa peo ya dipalesa. Tlaleho ya yona ya tlhahiso ya 5 kg/tree ha e bolele dilemo tsa sefate, tsamaiso, lebatowa la teko kapa hore boima ke ba dithollo kapa ba linate tse ka dikgaketleng; ha se ponelopele ya dijo tsa selemo tsa sefate se hodileng.
rows.ts: Texas Mission yi vekiwe eka ntlawa lowu lavaka ku titimela ngopfu naswona yi vula leswaku Nonpareil i muniki wa pholeni. Rhekhodo ya yona ya vuhumelerisi ya 5 kg/tree a yi vuli malembe ya nsinya, nhlayiso, xifundzha xa ndzingo kumbe leswaku ntiko i wa tindzoho kumbe wa timanga leti nga ni swifunengeto; a hi mvhumbo wa swakudya wa lembe wa nsinya lowu kuleke.
rows.ve: Texas Mission yo khethekanywa sa i ṱoḓaho murotholo munzhi nahone i bula Nonpareil sa muṋei wa muvhumbisi. Rekhodo yayo ya vhubveledzi ya 5 kg/tree a i buli miṅwaha ya muri, ndangulo, dzingu ḽa ndingo kana uri tshileme ndi tsha mbeu kana nḓuhu dzi re na makwati; a si mbonelaphanḓa ya zwiḽiwa zwa ṅwaha ya muri wo no aluwaho.

rows.english: The Texas Mission table's Production (kg/tree) row gives 5 kg/tree. It does not state tree age, reporting period, trial region or whether this means kernels or nuts in shell. Retained as a cultivar source claim to investigate; numeric mature annual kg remains null.
rows.zu: Umugqa othi Production (kg/tree) etafuleni le-Texas Mission unikeza 5 kg/tree. Awusho iminyaka yesihlahla, isikhathi sokubika, isifunda sesilingo noma ukuthi lokhu kusho izinhlamvu noma amantongomane anamagobolondo. Kugcinwa njengokushiwo ngumthombo wohlobo olutshalwayo okufanele kuphenywe; ama-kg onyaka esihlahla esikhulile asala engu-null.
rows.st: Mola wa Production (kg/tree) tafoleng ya Texas Mission o fana ka 5 kg/tree. Ha o bolele dilemo tsa sefate, nako ya tlaleho, lebatowa la teko kapa hore sena se bolela dithollo kapa linate tse ka dikgaketleng. E bolokwa e le polelo ya mohlodi ya mofuta o lengwang e lokelang ho fuputswa; kg tsa selemo tsa sefate se hodileng di sala e le null.
rows.ts: Ntila wa Production (kg/tree) eka tafula ra Texas Mission wu nyika 5 kg/tree. A wu vuli malembe ya nsinya, nkarhi wo vika, xifundzha xa ndzingo kumbe leswaku leswi swi vula tindzoho kumbe timanga leti nga ni swifunengeto. Swi hlayisiwa tani hi leswi vuriweke hi xihlovo xa muxaka lowu byariwaka leswaku swi lavisisiwa; kg ta lembe ta nsinya lowu kuleke ta ha ri null.
rows.ve: Mutalo wa Production (kg/tree) kha thebuḽu ya Texas Mission u ṋea 5 kg/tree. A u buli miṅwaha ya muri, tshifhinga tsha muvhigo, dzingu ḽa ndingo kana uri izwi zwi amba mbeu kana nḓuhu dzi re na makwati. Zwi vhulungwa sa zwe zwa bulwa nga tshiko tsha lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho uri zwi ṱoḓisiswe; kg dza ṅwaha dza muri wo no aluwaho dzi kha ḓi vha null.

rows.english: African Delight: age 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; age 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; mature orchards, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Full-bearing age and matched planting density are not stated; do not convert using Ruby Crisp spacing or interpolate a per-tree curve.
rows.zu: African Delight: iminyaka 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; iminyaka 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; izinsimu zezihlahla ezikhulile, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Iminyaka yokukhiqiza ngokugcwele nokuminyana kokutshala okuhambisana nalezi zibalo akushiwo; ungaguquli usebenzisa izikhala ze-Ruby Crisp noma uxhumanise isivuno ngokweminyaka sesihlahla ngasinye.
rows.st: African Delight: dilemo tse 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; dilemo tse 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; masimo a difate a hodileng, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Dilemo tsa tlhahiso e felletseng le palo ya dimela sebakeng e tsamaellanang le dipalo tsena ha di bolelwe; o se fetole ka ho sebedisa dikgeo tsa Ruby Crisp kapa wa hokahanya mola wa chai ka dilemo tsa sefate ka seng.
rows.ts: African Delight: malembe ya 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; malembe ya 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; masimu ya misinya leyi kuleke, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Malembe ya ku tswala hi ku helela ni nhlayo ya swimila endhawini leswi fambelanaka ni tinhlayo leti a swi vuriwanga; u nga cinci hi ku tirhisa mpfhuka wa Ruby Crisp kumbe u hlanganisa layini ya ntshovelo hi malembe ya nsinya wun’wana ni wun’wana.
rows.ve: African Delight: miṅwaha ya 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; miṅwaha ya 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; masimu a miri yo no aluwaho, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Miṅwaha ya u aṋwa nga vhuḓalo na tshivhalo tsha zwimela fhethu zwi tendelanaho na mbalo idzi a zwo ngo bulwa; ni songo zwi shandula nga u shumisa zwikhala zwa Ruby Crisp kana na ṱumanya mutevhe wa khaṋo nga miṅwaha ya muri muṅwe na muṅwe.

rows.english: Ruby Crisp achievable output is 30,000 kg/ha. Table 1 on PDF p.5 lists Ruby Crisp trial spacing 4 x 1.25 m and 2,000 trees/ha; the derived equivalent is 15 kg/tree, but the achievable claim is not explicitly the trial measurement or a mature-age benchmark. Keep native kg/ha and the qualification.
rows.zu: Ukukhiqiza okungafinyelelwa kwe-Ruby Crisp kungu-30,000 kg/ha. Itafula 1 ekhasini 5 le-PDF libala izikhala zesilingo se-Ruby Crisp ezingu-4 x 1.25 m nezihlahla ezingu-2,000 trees/ha; okulinganayo okutholakala ngokubala kungu-15 kg/tree, kodwa okushiwo ngokungafinyelelwa akushiwo ngokucacile njengesilinganiso sesilingo noma inkomba yeminyaka yesihlahla esikhulile. Gcina iyunithi yoqobo engu-kg/ha kanye nalo mbandela.
rows.st: Tlhahiso e ka fihlellwang ya Ruby Crisp ke 30,000 kg/ha. Tafole 1 leqepheng la 5 la PDF e thathamisa dikgeo tsa teko ya Ruby Crisp tsa 4 x 1.25 m le 2,000 trees/ha; tekano e fumanwang ka ho bala ke 15 kg/tree, empa polelo ya se ka fihlellwang ha e bolelwe ka ho hlaka e le tekanyo ya teko kapa tshupiso ya dilemo tsa sefate se hodileng. Boloka yuniti ya mohlodi ya kg/ha le pehelo ena.
rows.ts: Vuhumelerisi bya Ruby Crisp lowu nga fikeleriwaka i 30,000 kg/ha. Tafula ra 1 eka pheji ya 5 ya PDF ri xaxameta mpfhuka wa ndzingo wa Ruby Crisp wa 4 x 1.25 m ni 2,000 trees/ha; leswi ringanaka leswi humaka eka ku hlaya i 15 kg/tree, kambe leswi vuriwaka leswaku swi nga fikeleriwa a swi vuriwi hi ku kongoma ku va mpimo wa ndzingo kumbe xipimo xa malembe ya nsinya lowu kuleke. Hlayisa yuniti yo sungula ya kg/ha ni xipimelo lexi.
rows.ve: Vhubveledzi ha Ruby Crisp vhune ha nga swikelelwa ndi 30,000 kg/ha. Thebuḽu ya 1 kha siaṱari ḽa 5 ḽa PDF i vhea zwikhala zwa ndingo ya Ruby Crisp zwa 4 x 1.25 m na 2,000 trees/ha; zwi linganaho zwi bvaho kha u vhalela ndi 15 kg/tree, fhedzi zwine zwa bulwa uri zwi nga swikelelwa a zwo ngo bulwa nga vhuḓalo sa mupimo wa ndingo kana tshikalo tsha miṅwaha ya muri wo no aluwaho. Vhulungani yuniti ya tshiko ya kg/ha na nyimele iyi.

rows.english: Named requirement only: 200–400 Infruitec Chilling Units. The source data is from Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape and may not represent other areas. Confirm local chill, rootstock and pollen compatibility before buying.
rows.zu: Isidingo sohlobo oluqanjwe ngegama kuphela: 200–400 Infruitec Chilling Units. Idatha yomthombo ivela e-Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape futhi ingase ingameli ezinye izindawo. Qinisekisa amakhaza endawo, isiphunzi sokuxhunyelelwa nokuhambisana kwempova ngaphambi kokuthenga.
rows.st: Ke tlhoko ya mofuta o boletsweng ka lebitso feela: 200–400 Infruitec Chilling Units. Dintlha tsa mohlodi di tswa Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape mme di ka se emele dibaka tse ding. Netefatsa serame sa lehae, metso ya ho hlomathisa le ho dumellana ha peo ya dipalesa pele o reka.
rows.ts: I xilaveko xa muxaka lowu boxiweke hi vito ntsena: 200–400 Infruitec Chilling Units. Vuxokoxoko bya xihlovo byi huma eBien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape naswona byi nga ha va byi nga yimeli tindhawu tin’wana. Tiyisisa ku titimela ka laha kaya, timitsu to tlhoma ni ku fambelana ka pholeni u nga si xava.
rows.ve: Ndi ṱhoḓea ya lushaka lwo bulwaho nga dzina fhedzi: 200–400 Infruitec Chilling Units. Data ya tshiko i bva ngei Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape nahone i nga si imele huṅwe fhethu. Khwaṱhisedzani murotholo wa henefho, midzi ya u ṱumanya na u tendelana ha muvhumbisi musi ni sa athu u renga.

rows.english: Direct named production reference: 25 kg/tree at 4 × 1.5 m, Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape. Tree age and reporting period are not stated, so it is retained as an unaged cultivar reference, not generic annual mature output.
rows.zu: Umthombo oqondile wokukhiqiza oshiwo ngegama: 25 kg/tree ezikhaleni ezingu-4 × 1.5 m, e-Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape. Iminyaka yesihlahla nesikhathi sokubika akushiwo, ngakho kugcinwa njengomthombo wohlobo olutshalwayo ongenayo iminyaka, hhayi ukukhiqiza okuvamile konyaka kwesihlahla esikhulile.
rows.st: Tshupiso e tobileng ya tlhahiso e boletsweng ka lebitso: 25 kg/tree ho 4 × 1.5 m, Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape. Dilemo tsa sefate le nako ya tlaleho ha di bolelwe, kahoo e bolokwa e le tshupiso ya mofuta o lengwang e se nang dilemo, eseng tlhahiso e tlwaelehileng ya selemo ya sefate se hodileng.

Malembe ya nsinya ni nkarhi wo vika a swi vuriwanga, hikokwalaho xi hlayisiwa tani hi xihlovo xa muxaka lowu byariwaka lexi nga riki ni malembe, a hi vuhumelerisi bya ntolovelo bya lembe bya nsinya lowu kuleke.
