Miṅwaha ya muri na tshifhinga tsha muvhigo a zwo ngo bulwa, nga zwenezwo zwi vhulungwa sa tshiko tsha lushaka lu ṱavhiwaho tshi si na miṅwaha, hu si vhubveledzi ho ḓoweleaho ha ṅwaha ha muri wo no aluwaho.

rows.english: These are cultivar-specific compatible-pollen candidates, not a guarantee that any two pear trees pollinate one another.
rows.zu: Lezi yizinhlobo ezithile ezingenzeka zihambisane ngempova, akusona isiqinisekiso sokuthi noma yiziphi izihlahla ezimbili ze-pear zizompovana.
rows.st: Tsena ke mefuta e itseng e ka dumellanang ka peo ya dipalesa, eseng tiisetso ya hore difate dife kapa dife tse pedi tsa pear di tla tsamaisana peo ya dipalesa.
rows.ts: Leyi i mixaka yo karhi leyi nga fambelanaka hi pholeni, a hi xitiyisiso xa leswaku misinya yihi kumbe yihi yimbirhi ya pear yi ta nyiketa pholeni eka yin’wana.
rows.ve: Idzi ndi tshaka dzo khetheaho dzine dza nga tendelana nga muvhumbisi, a si khwaṱhisedzo ya uri miri miṅwe na miṅwe mivhili ya pear i ḓo ṋeana muvhumbisi.

rows.english: SAPO describes chilling qualitatively as low and production as high; neither supplies a numeric age or kg/tree.
rows.zu: I-SAPO ichaza amakhaza ngokuthi aphansi nokukhiqiza ngokuthi kuphezulu; akukho kulokhu okunikeza iminyaka eyinombolo noma kg/tree.
rows.st: SAPO e hlalosa serame ka mantswe e le se tlase le tlhahiso e le e phahameng; ha ho le e nngwe e fanang ka dilemo tsa dipalo kapa kg/tree.
rows.ts: SAPO yi hlamusela ku titimela hi marito leswaku ku le hansi ni vuhumelerisi leswaku byi le henhla; ku hava lexi nyikaka malembe ya nhlayo kumbe kg/tree.
rows.ve: SAPO i ṱalutshedza murotholo nga maipfi uri ndi muṱuku na vhubveledzi uri ndi vhunzhi; a hu na tshithihi tshine tsha ṋea miṅwaha ya mbalo kana kg/tree.

rows.english: The Ethiopian gesho-leaf brewing context establishes a specialist processed flavour use, not ordinary fresh fruit nutrition or a South African household recipe. No leaf kg/plant, food storage life or local harvest date is assigned.
rows.zu: Umongo wase-Ethiopia wokwenza isiphuzo ngamaqabunga e-gesho uqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okukhethekile kokunambitha okucutshunguliwe, hhayi umsoco wezithelo ezintsha ovamile noma iresiphi yasekhaya yaseNingizimu Afrika. Akunikezwanga kg/plant yamaqabunga, ubude besikhathi sokugcina ukudla noma usuku lokuvuna lwendawo.
rows.st: Maemo a Ethiopia a ho ritela ka makgasi a gesho a tiisa tshebediso e ikgethileng ya tatso e sebeditsweng, eseng phepo e tlwaelehileng ya ditholwana tse foreshe kapa risepe ya lelapa la Afrika Borwa. Ha ho kg/plant tsa makgasi, nako ya poloko ya dijo kapa letsatsi la kotulo la lehae tse abetsweng.
rows.ts: Xiyimo xa Ethiopia xa ku sweka swakunwa hi matluka ya gesho xi tiyisisa ku tirhisiwa ko hlawuleka ka nantswo lowu lulamisiweke, a hi swakudya swa ntolovelo swa mihandzu leyintshwa kumbe rhisipi ya le kaya ya Afrika-Dzonga. Ku hava kg/plant ta matluka, nkarhi wo hlayisa swakudya kumbe siku ro tshovela ra laha kaya leswi nyikiweke.
rows.ve: Nyimele ya Ethiopia ya u ita tshinwiwa nga maṱari a gesho i khwaṱhisedza u shumiswa ho khetheaho ha mudifho wo lugiswaho, hu si pfushi yo ḓoweleaho ya mitshelo misiwa kana resipi ya muṱa ya Afrika Tshipembe. A hu na kg/plant dza maṱari, vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha u vhulunga zwiḽiwa kana ḓuvha ḽa khaṋo ya henefho zwo avhelwaho.

rows.english: December–June berries are documented in the ecology account as wildlife food; this is not a verified human berry-picking window.
rows.zu: Amajikijolo ango-Disemba–Juni abhalwe engxenyeni yemvelo njengokudla kwezilwane zasendle; lesi akusona isikhathi esiqinisekisiwe sokuvuna amajikijolo adliwa abantu.
rows.st: Monokotshwai wa Tshitwe–Phupjane o ngotswe tlalehong ya tikoloho e le dijo tsa diphoofolo tse hlaha; ena ha se nako e netefaditsweng ya ho kotula monokotshwai wa batho.
rows.ts: Mihandzu leyitsongo ya N'wendzamhala–Khotavuxika yi tsariwile eka tsalwa ra mbango tani hi swakudya swa swiharhi swa nhova; lowu a hi nkarhi lowu tiyisisiweke wo tshovela mihandzu leyitsongo ya vanhu.
rows.ve: Mitshelo miṱuku ya Nyendavhusiku–Fulwi yo ṅwalwa kha muṱalutshedzo wa mvelo sa zwiḽiwa zwa zwipuka zwa ḓaka; itshi a si tshifhinga tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho tsha khaṋo ya mitshelo miṱuku ya vhathu.

rows.english: The source gives a ripe-berry interval. This does not establish stored jam months or safe shelf life.
rows.zu: Umthombo unikeza isikhathi samajikijolo avuthiwe. Lokhu akuqinisekisi izinyanga zokutholakala kwejamu egciniwe noma ubude besikhathi sokugcina obuphephile.
rows.st: Mohlodi o fana ka nako ya monokotshwai o butswitseng. Sena ha se tiise dikgwedi tsa jeme e bolokilweng kapa nako e bolokehileng ya poloko.
rows.ts: Xihlovo xi nyika nkarhi wa mihandzu leyitsongo leyi vupfeke. Leswi a swi tiyisisi tin’hweti ta jamu leyi hlayisiweke kumbe nkarhi lowu hlayisekeke wo hlayisa.
rows.ve: Tshiko tshi ṋea tshifhinga tsha mitshelo miṱuku yo vhibvaho. Izwi a zwi khwaṱhisedzi miṅwedzi ya dzhamu yo vhulungwaho kana vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha u vhulunga ho tsireledzeaho.

rows.english: Food is the berry; the same SANBI account reports poisonous tuberous roots. September–June describes berry occurrence, not a measured ripe-picking interval.
rows.zu: Ukudla yijikijolo; umbhalo ofanayo we-SANBI ubika izimpande ezivuvukele eziyizigaxa ezinobuthi. Septhemba–Juni kuchaza ukuvela kwamajikijolo, akusona isikhathi esilinganisiwe sokuvuna avuthiwe.
rows.st: Sejo ke monokotshwai; tlaleho yona eo ya SANBI e tlaleha metso e ruruhileng e nang le tjhefo. Leotshe–Phupjane e hlalosa ho hlaha ha monokotshwai, eseng nako e lekantsweng ya ho kotula o butswitseng.
rows.ts: Swakudya i muhandzu lowutsongo; tsalwa rero ra SANBI ri vika timitsu leti pfimbaneke ta chefu. Ndzhati–Khotavuxika swi hlamusela ku humelela ka mihandzu leyitsongo, a hi nkarhi lowu pimiweke wo tshovela leyi vupfeke.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa ndi mutshelo muṱuku; muṱalutshedzo wonoyo wa SANBI u vhiga midzi yo kukumuwaho i re na mulimo. Khubvumedzi–Fulwi zwi ṱalutshedza u vhonala ha mitshelo miṱuku, a si tshifhinga tsho pimwaho tsha khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho.

rows.english: The brochure uses the older botanical name Rosmarinus officinalis; catalogue identity is preserved. It documents food seasoning leaves and separate essential oil uses, without a food-leaf yield, first cut age or local picking calendar.
rows.zu: Incwajana isebenzisa igama elidala lesayensi yezitshalo elithi Rosmarinus officinalis; ubunikazi bekhathalogi buyagcinwa. Ibhala amaqabunga okunandisa ukudla nokusetshenziswa okuhlukile kwamafutha ephunga, ngaphandle kwesivuno samaqabunga okudla, iminyaka yokusika kokuqala noma ikhalenda lendawo lokuvuna.
rows.st: Bukana e sebedisa lebitso la kgale la saense la Rosmarinus officinalis; boitsebiso ba khathaloko bo bolokwa. E ngola makgasi a ho natefisa dijo le tshebediso e fapaneng ya oli ya monko, e se na chai ya makgasi a dijo, dilemo tsa ho seha ha pele kapa khalendara ya lehae ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Broxara yi tirhisa vito ra khale ra swimila ra Rosmarinus officinalis; vuxokoxoko bya muxaka wa khathalogo bya hlayisiwa. Yi tsala matluka yo nandzihisa swakudya ni ku tirhisiwa kun’wana ka mafurha ya nun’hwelo, yi nga ri ni ntshovelo wa matluka ya swakudya, malembe ya ku tsema ko sungula kumbe khalendara yo tshovela ya laha kaya.
rows.ve: Bugwana i shumisa dzina ḽa kale ḽa saintsi ḽa Rosmarinus officinalis; vhuvha ha khathaḽogo vhu a vhulungwa. I ṅwala maṱari a u ṋea zwiḽiwa mudifho na u shumiswa ho fhambanaho ha mapfura a munukhelelo, hu si na khaṋo ya maṱari a zwiḽiwa, miṅwaha ya u tshea lwa u thoma kana khaḽenda ya khaṋo ya henefho.

rows.english: Edibility is recorded for this exact variety; do not apply the common name boer-bean to every species as food evidence.
rows.zu: Ukudliwa kubhalwe ngalolu hlobo oluthile kuphela; ungasebenzisi igama elivamile elithi boer-bean njengobufakazi bokudla kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo.
rows.st: Ho jewa ho rekotilwe bakeng sa mofuta ona o itseng; o se sebedise lebitso le tlwaelehileng la boer-bean bakeng sa mefuta yohle ya dimela e le bopaki ba dijo.
rows.ts: Ku dyiwa ku rhekhodiwile eka muxaka lowu hi ku kongoma; u nga tirhisi vito ra ntolovelo ra boer-bean eka mixaka hinkwayo ya swimila tani hi vumbhoni bya swakudya.
rows.ve: U ḽiwa ho rekhodiwa kha lushaka ulu lwo teaho; ni songo shumisa dzina ḽo ḓoweleaho ḽa boer-bean kha tshaka dzoṱhe dza zwimela sa vhuṱanzi ha zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: September–January describes fruit production; exact ripe-picking dates are not stated. Do not count leaves used as livestock fodder as household food.
rows.zu: Septhemba–Januwari kuchaza ukukhiqizwa kwezithelo; izinsuku eziqondile zokuvuna ezivuthiwe azishiwo. Ungabali amaqabunga asetshenziswa njengefolishi lezilwane njengokudla kwasekhaya.
rows.st: Leotshe–Pherekgong e hlalosa tlhahiso ya ditholwana; matsatsi a nepahetseng a ho kotula tse butswitseng ha a bolelwe. O se bale makgasi a sebediswang e le furu ya diphoofolo e le dijo tsa lelapa.
rows.ts: Ndzhati–Sunguti swi hlamusela ku humesa mihandzu; masiku yo tshovela leyi vupfeke hi ku kongoma a ma vuriwanga. U nga hlayi matluka lama tirhisiwaka tani hi furu ya swifuwo ku va swakudya swa le kaya.
rows.ve: Khubvumedzi–Phando zwi ṱalutshedza u bveledzwa ha mitshelo; maḓuvha o teaho a khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho a o ngo bulwa. Ni songo vhalela maṱari a shumiswaho sa furu ya zwifuwo sa zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa.

rows.english: The primary account establishes edible ripe fruit and October–June fruit appearance. That interval includes developing fruit and is retained only as phenology, not a ripe picking calendar. No annual food kg or bearing age is supplied.
rows.zu: Umbhalo wokuqala uqinisekisa izithelo ezivuthiwe ezidliwayo nokuvela kwezithelo ngo-Okthoba–Juni. Leso sikhathi sihlanganisa izithelo ezisakhula futhi sigcinwa njengezikhathi zezigaba zokukhula kuphela, hhayi ikhalenda lokuvuna ezivuthiwe. Akunikezwanga ama-kg okudla ngonyaka noma iminyaka yokuqala ukuthela.
rows.st: Tlaleho ya mantlha e tiisa ditholwana tse butswitseng tse jewang le ho hlaha ha ditholwana ka Mphalane–Phupjane. Nako eo e kenyelletsa ditholwana tse ntseng di hola mme e bolokwa feela e le dinako tsa mekgahlelo ya kgolo, eseng khalendara ya kotulo ya tse butswitseng. Ha ho kg tsa dijo ka selemo kapa dilemo tsa ho qala ho beha tse fuweng.
rows.ts: Tsalwa ro sungula ri tiyisisa mihandzu leyi vupfeke leyi dyiwaka ni ku humelela ka mihandzu hi Nhlangula–Khotavuxika. Nkarhi wolowo wu katsa mihandzu leyi ya ha kulaka naswona wu hlayisiwa ntsena tani hi minkarhi ya swiyimo swa ku kula, a hi khalendara yo tshovela leyi vupfeke. Ku hava kg ta swakudya hi lembe kumbe malembe yo sungula ku tswala leswi nyikiweke.
rows.ve: Muṱalutshedzo wa u thoma u khwaṱhisedza mitshelo yo vhibvaho i ḽiwaho na u vhonala ha mitshelo nga Tshimedzi–Fulwi. Tshifhinga itsho tshi katela mitshelo i kha ḓi aluwaho nahone tshi vhulungwa fhedzi sa zwifhinga zwa maga a u aluwa, hu si khaḽenda ya khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho. A hu na kg dza zwiḽiwa nga ṅwaha kana miṅwaha ya u thoma u aṋwa zwo ṋewaho.

rows.english: The primary account establishes edible ripe fruit and February–July fruit appearance. That interval includes developing fruit and is retained only as phenology, not a ripe picking calendar. No annual food kg or bearing age is supplied.
rows.zu: Umbhalo wokuqala uqinisekisa izithelo ezivuthiwe ezidliwayo nokuvela kwezithelo ngo-Februwari–Julayi. Leso sikhathi sihlanganisa izithelo ezisakhula futhi sigcinwa njengezikhathi zezigaba zokukhula kuphela, hhayi ikhalenda lokuvuna ezivuthiwe. Akunikezwanga ama-kg okudla ngonyaka noma iminyaka yokuqala ukuthela.
rows.st: Tlaleho ya mantlha e tiisa ditholwana tse butswitseng tse jewang le ho hlaha ha ditholwana ka Hlakola–Phupu. Nako eo e kenyelletsa ditholwana tse ntseng di hola mme e bolokwa feela e le dinako tsa mekgahlelo ya kgolo, eseng khalendara ya kotulo ya tse butswitseng. Ha ho kg tsa dijo ka selemo kapa dilemo tsa ho qala ho beha tse fuweng.
rows.ts: Tsalwa ro sungula ri tiyisisa mihandzu leyi vupfeke leyi dyiwaka ni ku humelela ka mihandzu hi Nyenyenyani–Mawuwani. Nkarhi wolowo wu katsa mihandzu leyi ya ha kulaka naswona wu hlayisiwa ntsena tani hi minkarhi ya swiyimo swa ku kula, a hi khalendara yo tshovela leyi vupfeke. Ku hava kg ta swakudya hi lembe kumbe malembe yo sungula ku tswala leswi nyikiweke.
rows.ve: Muṱalutshedzo wa u thoma u khwaṱhisedza mitshelo yo vhibvaho i ḽiwaho na u vhonala ha mitshelo nga Luhuhi–Fulwana. Tshifhinga itsho tshi katela mitshelo i kha ḓi aluwaho nahone tshi vhulungwa fhedzi sa zwifhinga zwa maga a u aluwa, hu si khaḽenda ya khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho. A hu na kg dza zwiḽiwa nga ṅwaha kana miṅwaha ya u thoma u aṋwa zwo ṋewaho.

rows.english: The discussion explicitly includes S. undulata among edible dried ripe currant fruits and traditional fermentation uses. Its host article species calendar is not transferred to S. undulata.
rows.zu: Ingxoxo ifaka ngokucacile i-S. undulata phakathi kwezithelo ze-currant ezivuthiwe ezomisiwe ezidliwayo nasekusetshenzisweni kwendabuko kokuvutshelwa. Ikhalenda lohlobo lwesitshalo okukhulunywa ngalo esihlokweni esiqukethe le ngxoxo alidluliselwa ku-S. undulata.
rows.st: Puisano e kenyelletsa ka ho hlaka S. undulata hara ditholwana tsa currant tse butswitseng tse omisitsweng tse jewang le tshebediso ya setso ya ho belisa. Khalendara ya mofuta wa semela wa sehlooho se tshwereng puisano ena ha e fetisetswe ho S. undulata.
rows.ts: Mbulo wu katsa hi ku kongoma S. undulata eka mihandzu ya currant leyi vupfeke yi omisiwa leyi dyiwaka ni ku tirhisiwa ka ndhavuko ka ku virisa. Khalendara ya muxaka wa ximilana wa xihloko lexi mbulo lowu wu nga eka xona a yi hundziseriwi eka S. undulata.
rows.ve: Khaseledzo i katela nga vhuḓalo S. undulata kha mitshelo ya currant yo vhibvaho yo omiswaho i ḽiwaho na u shumiswa ha sialala ha u bilisa. Khaḽenda ya lushaka lwa tshimela lwa athikili ine khaseledzo iyi ya vha khayo a i pfukiselwi kha S. undulata.

rows.english: Assessment identifies the catalogue species and Northern/Western Cape distribution; it does not provide a harvest calendar or food yield.
rows.zu: Ukuhlolwa kuhlonza uhlobo lwesitshalo olusekhathalogini nokusabalala kwaso e-Northern/Western Cape; akunikezi ikhalenda lokuvuna noma isivuno sokudla.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo e hlwaya mofuta wa semela wa khathaloko le kabo ya wona Northern/Western Cape; ha e fane ka khalendara ya kotulo kapa chai ya dijo.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wu tiva muxaka wa ximilana wa khathalogo ni ku hangalaka ka wona eNorthern/Western Cape; a wu nyiki khalendara yo tshovela kumbe ntshovelo wa swakudya.
rows.ve: Ṱhoḓisiso i topola lushaka lwa tshimela lwa khathaḽogo na u phaḓalala halwo ngei Northern/Western Cape; a i ṋei khaḽenda ya khaṋo kana khaṋo ya zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: SANBI qualifies the food statement; it is about ripe berries, not latex, bark or roots. Fruit presence February–September does not establish ripe picking throughout.
rows.zu: I-SANBI ibeka imibandela kokushiwo ngokudla; kuphathelene namajikijolo avuthiwe, hhayi ubisi lwesitshalo, amagxolo noma izimpande. Ukuba khona kwezithelo ngo-Februwari–Septhemba akuqinisekisi ukuvunwa kokuvuthiwe kuso sonke leso sikhathi.
rows.st: SANBI e beha dipehelo polelong ya dijo; e bua ka monokotshwai o butswitseng, eseng lebese la semela, makgapetla kapa metso. Ho ba teng ha ditholwana ka Hlakola–Leotshe ha ho tiise kotulo ya tse butswitseng nakong eo yohle.
rows.ts: SANBI yi veka swipimelo eka leswi vuriwaka hi swakudya; swi khumba mihandzu leyitsongo leyi vupfeke, a hi ntswamba wa ximilana, mahanti kumbe timitsu. Ku va kona ka mihandzu hi Nyenyenyani–Ndzhati a swi tiyisisi ku tshovela leyi vupfeke eka nkarhi wolowo hinkwawo.
rows.ve: SANBI i vhea nyimele kha fhungo ḽa zwiḽiwa; ḽi kwama mitshelo miṱuku yo vhibvaho, hu si mafhi a tshimela, makwati kana midzi. U vha hone ha mitshelo nga Luhuhi–Khubvumedzi a zwi khwaṱhisedzi khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho kha tshifhinga tshenetsho tshoṱhe.

rows.english: The primary study records confusion with Bridelia micrantha. It does not supply a safe harvest calendar or kg/tree.
rows.zu: Ucwaningo lokuqala lubhala ukudidaniswa ne-Bridelia micrantha. Alunikezi ikhalenda lokuvuna eliphephile noma kg/tree.
rows.st: Patlisiso ya mantlha e rekota pherekano le Bridelia micrantha. Ha e fane ka khalendara e bolokehileng ya kotulo kapa kg/tree.
rows.ts: Ndzavisiso wo sungula wu rhekhoda ku pfilunganyiwa na Bridelia micrantha. A wu nyiki khalendara yo tshovela leyi hlayisekeke kumbe kg/tree.
rows.ve: Ṱhoḓisiso ya u thoma i rekhoda u kanganyiswa na Bridelia micrantha. A i ṋei khaḽenda ya khaṋo yo tsireledzeaho kana kg/tree.

rows.english: The review states August–December but does not identify a locality for that interval. Related monkey-orange literature discusses this interval in Zimbabwe and more than one Strychnos species; it does not establish a South African spinosa picking calendar. The former South Africa (general) window is withheld. Record the farm's own ripe-pulp months; seeds and unripe pulp are not ordinary food.
rows.zu: Ukubuyekezwa kuthi Agasti–Disemba kodwa akuvezi indawo yaleso sikhathi. Izincwadi ezihlobene ne-monkey-orange zikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi e-Zimbabwe nasezinhlotsheni ze-Strychnos ezingaphezu kolulodwa; lokhu akuqinisekisi ikhalenda lokuvuna i-spinosa laseNingizimu Afrika. Isikhathi sangaphambili esithi South Africa (general) sibanjelwe ngaphandle. Bhala izinyanga zepulazi zokuvuna inyama yesithelo evuthiwe; imbewu nenyama engakavuthwa akukhona ukudla okuvamile.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo e bolela Phata–Tshitwe empa ha e hlalose sebaka sa nako eo. Dingolwa tse amanang le monkey-orange di bua ka nako ena Zimbabwe le ka mefuta e fetang o le mong ya Strychnos; ha e tiise khalendara ya kotulo ya spinosa ya Afrika Borwa. Nako ya pele ya South Africa (general) e tshwaretswe ka ntle. Rekota dikgwedi tsa polasi ka boyona tsa nama ya tholwana e butswitseng; peo le nama e sa butswang ha se dijo tse tlwaelehileng.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wu vula Mhawuri–N'wendzamhala kambe a wu tivi ndhawu ya nkarhi wolowo. Matsalwa lama fambelanaka ni monkey-orange ma bula hi nkarhi lowu eZimbabwe ni hi mixaka leyi hundzaka wun’we ya Strychnos; a swi tiyisisi khalendara yo tshovela spinosa ya Afrika-Dzonga. Nkarhi wa khale wa South Africa (general) wu khomiwe ehandle. Rhekhoda tin’hweti ta purasi hi roxe ta nyama ya muhandzu leyi vupfeke; mbewu ni nyama leyi nga vupfangiki a hi swakudya swa ntolovelo.
rows.ve: Tsedzuluso i bula Ṱhangule–Nyendavhusiku fhedzi a i topoli fhethu ha tshifhinga itsho. Maṅwalwa a elanaho na monkey-orange a amba nga tshifhinga itshi ngei Zimbabwe na nga tshaka dzi fhiraho luthihi dza Strychnos; a zwi khwaṱhisedzi khaḽenda ya khaṋo ya spinosa ya Afrika Tshipembe. Tshifhinga tsha kale tsha South Africa (general) tsho farelwa nnḓa. Rekhodani miṅwedzi ya bulasi nga ḽone iṋe ya ṋama ya mutshelo yo vhibvaho; mbeu na ṋama i songo vhibvaho a si zwiḽiwa zwo ḓoweleaho.

rows.english: The 2021 review cites this Benin study for its 3–5-year bearing-age statement. The cited source's geography is West Africa, not a South African orchard. Retain the review's numeric statement with this condition; no local annual yield curve is supplied.
rows.zu: Ukubuyekezwa kwango-2021 kucaphuna lolu cwaningo lwase-Benin esitatimendeni salo seminyaka engu-3–5 yokuqala ukuthela. Indawo yomthombo ocashuniwe yi-West Africa, hhayi insimu yezihlahla yaseNingizimu Afrika. Gcina isitatimende sezinombolo sokubuyekezwa kanye nalo mbandela; alikho ijika lesivuno sendawo lonyaka elinikeziwe.
rows.st: Tlhahlobo ya 2021 e qotsa patlisiso ena ya Benin bakeng sa polelo ya yona ya dilemo tse 3–5 tsa ho qala ho beha. Sebaka sa mohlodi o qotsitsweng ke West Africa, eseng tshimo ya difate ya Afrika Borwa. Boloka polelo ya dipalo ya tlhahlobo le pehelo ena; ha ho mola wa chai ya selemo ya lehae o fuweng.
rows.ts: Nkambisiso wa 2021 wu tshaha ndzavisiso lowu wa Benin eka xivulwa xa wona xa malembe ya 3–5 yo sungula ku tswala. Ndhawu ya xihlovo lexi tshahiweke i West Africa, a hi nsimu ya misinya ya Afrika-Dzonga. Hlayisa xivulwa xa tinhlayo xa nkambisiso ni xipimelo lexi; ku hava layini ya ntshovelo wa lembe ya laha kaya leyi nyikiweke.
rows.ve: Tsedzuluso ya 2021 i bula ṱhoḓisiso iyi ya Benin kha fhungo ḽayo ḽa miṅwaha ya 3–5 ya u thoma u aṋwa. Fhethu ha tshiko tsho bulwaho ndi West Africa, hu si tsimu ya miri ya Afrika Tshipembe. Vhulungani fhungo ḽa mbalo ḽa tsedzuluso na nyimele iyi; a hu na mutevhe wa khaṋo ya ṅwaha ya henefho wo ṋewaho.

rows.english: The original PROTA account dates flowering and fruiting but does not date ripening. SANBI describes red to dark-purple ripe berries without ripe picking months. The November–March observation is retained as southern African phenology; local food-ready picking months remain unknown.
rows.zu: Umbhalo wokuqala we-PROTA ubeka izikhathi zokuqhakaza nokuthela kodwa awubeki isikhathi sokuvuthwa. I-SANBI ichaza amajikijolo avuthiwe abomvu kuya konsomi omnyama ngaphandle kwezinyanga zokuvuna avuthiwe. Okubonwe ngo-Novemba–Mashi kugcinwa njengezikhathi zezigaba zokukhula eningizimu ye-Afrika; izinyanga zendawo zokuvuna ukudla okulungele ukudliwa zisalokhu zingaziwa.
rows.st: Tlaleho ya pele ya PROTA e beha dinako tsa ho thunya le ho beha empa ha e behe nako ya ho butswa. SANBI e hlalosa monokotshwai o butswitseng o mofubedu ho isa ho pherese e lefifi ntle le dikgwedi tsa ho kotula o butswitseng. Tse bonweng ka Pundungwane–Hlakubele di bolokwa e le dinako tsa mekgahlelo ya kgolo borwa ba Afrika; dikgwedi tsa lehae tsa kotulo ya dijo tse seng di loketse ho jewa di ntse di sa tsejwe.
rows.ts: Tsalwa ro sungula ra PROTA ri veka minkarhi ya ku rhumbuka ni ku tswala kambe a ri veki nkarhi wa ku vupfa. SANBI yi hlamusela mihandzu leyitsongo leyi vupfeke ya ku tshwuka ku fika eka xivunguvungu xa ntima handle ka tin’hweti to tshovela leyi vupfeke. Leswi voniweke hi Hukuri–Nyenyankulu swi hlayisiwa tani hi minkarhi ya swiyimo swa ku kula edzongeni wa Afrika; tin’hweti ta laha kaya to tshovela swakudya leswi lunghekeleke ku dyiwa ta ha ri leti nga tivekiki.
rows.ve: Muṱalutshedzo wa u thoma wa PROTA u vhea zwifhinga zwa u ṱuma maluvha na u aṋwa fhedzi a u vhei tshifhinga tsha u vhibva. SANBI i ṱalutshedza mitshelo miṱuku yo vhibvaho mitswuku u swika kha phephulu ya swiswi hu si na miṅwedzi ya khaṋo ya yo vhibvaho. Zwo vhonwaho nga Ḽara–Ṱhafamuhwe zwi vhulungwa sa zwifhinga zwa maga a u aluwa tshipembe ha Afrika; miṅwedzi ya henefho ya khaṋo ya zwiḽiwa zwo lugelaho u ḽiwa i kha ḓi vha i sa ḓivhei.

rows.english: New rainy-season growth gives the best tops; wash off coastal sand thoroughly and boil for the documented vegetable preparation. August–November flowering is not leaf availability.
rows.zu: Ukukhula okusha ngesikhathi semvula kunikeza izihloko ezinhle kakhulu; geza ususe kahle isihlabathi sasogwini bese ubilisa njengokulungiswa kwemifino okubhaliwe. Ukuqhakaza ngo-Agasti–Novemba akusho ukutholakala kwamaqabunga.
rows.st: Kgolo e ntjha nakong ya dipula e fana ka dikarolo tse hodimo tse ntle ka ho fetisisa; hlatswa lehlabathe la lebopo hantle mme o di bedise bakeng sa tokiso ya meroho e ngotsweng. Ho thunya ka Phata–Pundungwane ha se ho fumaneha ha makgasi.
rows.ts: Ku kula lokuntshwa hi nguva ya mpfula ku nyika swiphemu swa le henhla leswinene ngopfu; hlantswa sandi ra le ribuweni hi ku hetiseka kutani u virisa hi ndlela ya ku lulamisa matsavu leyi tsariweke. Ku rhumbuka hi Mhawuri–Hukuri a hi ku kumeka ka matluka.
rows.ve: U aluwa huswa nga tshifhinga tsha mvula hu ṋea zwipiḓa zwa nṱha zwavhuḓisa; ṱanzwani muṱavha wa tsini na lwanzhe nga vhuḓalo ni vhilise u ya nga kulugisele kwa miroho kwo ṅwalwaho. U ṱuma maluvha nga Ṱhangule–Ḽara a si u wanala ha maṱari.

rows.english: The account describes boiling young shoots until tender. September–January flowering is not a shoot harvest calendar; fodder output is not household food kg.
rows.zu: Umbhalo uchaza ukubilisela amahlumela amancane aze athambe. Ukuqhakaza ngo-Septhemba–Januwari akulona ikhalenda lokuvuna amahlumela; ukukhiqiza ifolishi akuwona ama-kg okudla kwasekhaya.
rows.st: Tlaleho e hlalosa ho bedisa mahlomela a manyane ho fihlela a le bonolo. Ho thunya ka Leotshe–Pherekgong ha se khalendara ya ho kotula mahlomela; tlhahiso ya furu ha se kg tsa dijo tsa lelapa.
rows.ts: Tsalwa ri hlamusela ku virisa mahluke lamatsongo ku fika ya olova. Ku rhumbuka hi Ndzhati–Sunguti a hi khalendara yo tshovela mahluke; vuhumelerisi bya furu a hi kg ta swakudya swa le kaya.
rows.ve: Muṱalutshedzo u bula u vhilisa mihlavhi miṱuku u swika i tshi leluwa. U ṱuma maluvha nga Khubvumedzi–Phando a si khaḽenda ya khaṋo ya mihlavhi; vhubveledzi ha furu a si kg dza zwiḽiwa zwa muṱa.

rows.english: Coastal-sand perennial with edible congested flower buds. The stated July–September flowering interval does not identify exact unopened-bud picking months.
rows.zu: Isitshalo esiphila iminyaka eminingi esikhula esihlabathini sasogwini, esinamahlumela ezimbali aminyene adliwayo. Isikhathi esishiwo sokuqhakaza sika-Julayi–Septhemba asihlonzi izinyanga eziqondile zokuvuna amahlumela ezimbali angakavuleki.
rows.st: Semela se phelang dilemo tse ngata sa lehlabathe la lebopo se nang le mahlomela a dipalesa a teteaneng a jewang. Nako e boletsweng ya ho thunya ya Phupu–Leotshe ha e hlwaye dikgwedi tse nepahetseng tsa ho kotula mahlomela a dipalesa a eso bulehe.
rows.ts: Ximilana lexi hanyaka malembe yo tala xa sandi ra le ribuweni lexi nga ni swirhumbana swa swiluva leswi tsindzikelaneke leswi dyiwaka. Nkarhi wa ku rhumbuka lowu boxiweke wa Mawuwani–Ndzhati a wu tivi tin’hweti hi ku kongoma to tshovela swirhumbana swa swiluva leswi nga si pfuleka.
rows.ve: Tshimela tshi tshilaho miṅwaha minzhi tsha muṱavha wa tsini na lwanzhe tshi re na maluvha a sa athu u vulea a tsitsikanaho a ḽiwaho. Tshifhinga tsho bulwaho tsha u ṱuma maluvha tsha Fulwana–Khubvumedzi a tshi topoli miṅwedzi yo teaho ya khaṋo ya maluvha a sa athu u vulea.

rows.english: The human food product is young leaves. Berries described as bird/bat food are not promoted to a human fruit harvest. No leaf cutting age, exact months or household leaf kg is given.
rows.zu: Umkhiqizo wokudla kwabantu ngamaqabunga amancane. Amajikijolo achazwe njengokudla kwezinyoni/amalulwane awenziwa isivuno sezithelo sabantu. Akunikeziwe iminyaka yokusika amaqabunga, izinyanga eziqondile noma ama-kg amaqabunga asekhaya.
rows.st: Sehlahiswa sa dijo tsa batho ke makgasi a manyane. Monokotshwai o hlaloswang e le dijo tsa dinonyana/bommankgane ha o etswe kotulo ya ditholwana ya batho. Ha ho dilemo tsa ho seha makgasi, dikgwedi tse nepahetseng kapa kg tsa makgasi tsa lelapa tse fuweng.
rows.ts: Xikumiwa xa swakudya swa vanhu i matluka lamatsongo. Mihandzu leyitsongo leyi hlamuseriwaka tani hi swakudya swa tinyenyana/vamange a yi endliwi ntshovelo wa mihandzu wa vanhu. Ku hava malembe ya ku tsema matluka, tin’hweti hi ku kongoma kumbe kg ta matluka ta le kaya leswi nyikiweke.
rows.ve: Tshibveledzwa tsha zwiḽiwa zwa vhathu ndi maṱari maṱuku. Mitshelo miṱuku i ṱalutshedzwaho sa zwiḽiwa zwa zwiṋoni/vhomamange a i itwi khaṋo ya mitshelo ya vhathu. A hu na miṅwaha ya u tshea maṱari, miṅwedzi yo teaho kana kg dza maṱari dza muṱa zwo ṋewaho.

rows.english: Leaves and flowers are documented culinary parts. Medicinal bulb use does not make every part a food.
rows.zu: Amaqabunga nezimbali kubhalwe njengezingxenye zokupheka. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-bulb njengomuthi akwenzi yonke ingxenye ibe ukudla.
rows.st: Makgasi le dipalesa di ngotswe e le dikarolo tsa ho pheha. Tshebediso ya bulb e le moriana ha e etse karolo e nngwe le e nngwe dijo.
rows.ts: Matluka ni swiluva swi tsariwile tani hi swiphemu swa ku sweka. Ku tirhisa bulb tani hi murhi a swi endli xiphemu xin’wana ni xin’wana ku va swakudya.
rows.ve: Maṱari na maluvha zwo ṅwalwa sa zwipiḓa zwa u bika. U shumisa bulb sa mushonga a zwi iti uri tshipiḓa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi vhe zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: This account separately distinguishes green unripe and brown ripe fruit, but its November–April biology sentence does not date that ripening change. The wider interval remains southern African phenology. SANBI's January–April description of ripe edible fruit supplies the food-ready regional reference.
rows.zu: Lo mbhalo uhlukanisa ngokwehlukana izithelo eziluhlaza ezingakavuthwa nezinsundu ezivuthiwe, kodwa umusho wawo wezinto eziphilayo wango-Novemba–Ephreli awubeki isikhathi salolo shintsho lokuvuthwa. Isikhathi esibanzi sihlala siyizikhathi zezigaba zokukhula eningizimu ye-Afrika. Incazelo ye-SANBI ka-Januwari–Ephreli yezithelo ezivuthiwe ezidliwayo inikeza umthombo wesifunda wokudla okulungele ukudliwa.
rows.st: Tlaleho ena e kgetholla ka thoko ditholwana tse tala tse sa butswang le tse sootho tse butswitseng, empa polelo ya yona ya bophelo ya Pundungwane–Mmesa ha e behe nako ya phetoho eo ya ho butswa. Nako e pharaletseng e sala e le dinako tsa mekgahlelo ya kgolo borwa ba Afrika. Tlhaloso ya SANBI ya Pherekgong–Mmesa ya ditholwana tse butswitseng tse jewang e fana ka tshupiso ya lebatowa ya dijo tse loketseng ho jewa.
rows.ts: Tsalwa leri ri hambanisa hi ku hambana mihandzu ya rihlaza leyi nga vupfangiki ni ya buraweni leyi vupfeke, kambe xivulwa xa rona xa ku hanya xa Hukuri–Dzivamisoko a xi veki nkarhi wa ku cinca koloko ka ku vupfa. Nkarhi wo anama wa ha ri minkarhi ya swiyimo swa ku kula edzongeni wa Afrika. Nhlamuselo ya SANBI ya Sunguti–Dzivamisoko ya mihandzu leyi vupfeke leyi dyiwaka yi nyika xihlovo xa xifundzha xa swakudya leswi lunghekeleke ku dyiwa.
rows.ve: Muṱalutshedzo uyu u khethekanya nga u fhambana mitshelo midala i songo vhibvaho na ya buraweni yo vhibvaho, fhedzi fhungo ḽayo ḽa vhutshilo ḽa Ḽara–Lambamai a ḽi vhei tshifhinga tsha tshanduko yeneyo ya u vhibva. Tshifhinga tsho ṱanḓavhuwaho tshi dzula tshi zwifhinga zwa maga a u aluwa tshipembe ha Afrika. Ṱhalutshedzo ya SANBI ya Phando–Lambamai ya mitshelo yo vhibvaho i ḽiwaho i ṋea tshiko tsha dzingu tsha zwiḽiwa zwo lugelaho u ḽiwa.

rows.english: Year 4 commercial budget: 4,400 cartons/ha at 4.5 kg/carton = 19,800 kg/ha. The source does not provide matched vines/ha or row/vine spacing, so no kg/vine is derived. This is a budget assumption for one cultivar and region, not a generic full-bearing age or a local mapped-vine production record.
rows.zu: Isabelomali sokuhweba sonyaka 4: 4,400 cartons/ha ngo-4.5 kg/carton = 19,800 kg/ha. Umthombo awunikezi vines/ha noma izikhala zomugqa/umvini ezihambisana nalezi zibalo, ngakho akukho kg/vine okubalwayo. Lokhu kuwukucatshangwa kwesabelomali sohlobo olulodwa olutshalwayo nesifunda esisodwa, akuyona iminyaka evamile yokukhiqiza ngokugcwele noma irekhodi lokukhiqiza lomvini wendawo osebalazweni.
rows.st: Tekanyetso ya kgwebo ya selemo sa 4: 4,400 cartons/ha ho 4.5 kg/carton = 19,800 kg/ha. Mohlodi ha o fane ka vines/ha kapa dikgeo tsa mola/morara tse tsamaellanang le dipalo tsena, kahoo ha ho kg/vine e balwang. Ena ke kgakanyo ya tekanyetso ya mofuta o le mong o lengwang le lebatowa le le leng, eseng dilemo tse tlwaelehileng tsa tlhahiso e felletseng kapa rekoto ya tlhahiso ya morara wa lehae o mmapeng.
rows.ts: Mpimanyeto wa bindzu wa lembe ra 4: 4,400 cartons/ha eka 4.5 kg/carton = 19,800 kg/ha. Xihlovo a xi nyiki vines/ha kumbe mpfhuka wa ntila/murhi wa madiriva leswi fambelanaka ni tinhlayo leti, hikokwalaho ku hava kg/vine leyi hlayiwaka. Lexi i ku ringanyeta ka mpimanyeto wa muxaka wun’we lowu byariwaka ni xifundzha xin’we, a hi malembe ya ntolovelo ya ku tswala hi ku helela kumbe rhekhodo ya vuhumelerisi ya murhi wa madiriva wa laha kaya lowu nga eka mepe.
rows.ve: Mugaganyagwama wa bindu wa ṅwaha wa 4: 4,400 cartons/ha kha 4.5 kg/carton = 19,800 kg/ha. Tshiko a tshi ṋei vines/ha kana zwikhala zwa mutalo/muri wa nḓirivhe zwi tendelanaho na mbalo idzi, nga zwenezwo a hu na kg/vine dzi vhalelwaho. Iyi ndi khumbulelo ya mugaganyagwama ya lushaka luthihi lu ṱavhiwaho na dzingu ḽithihi, a si miṅwaha yo ḓoweleaho ya u aṋwa nga vhuḓalo kana rekhodo ya vhubveledzi ya muri wa nḓirivhe wa henefho u re kha mapa.

rows.english: Pretoria Hillcrest rain-shelter trial, 2015/16 and 2016/17, drip irrigation on sandy clay loam. Commercial ginger Z. officinale at eight months: 38.3 t/ha fresh and 8.8 t/ha dry rhizomes in the well-watered treatment; African ginger was a different species with different values. No matched plant density is supplied, so no kg/plant or household drying conversion is derived. The abstract says open field, while Methods specifies rain shelter; conditions are retained.
rows.zu: Isilingo esivikelwe emvuleni sase-Pretoria Hillcrest, ngo-2015/16 nango-2016/17, ngokunisela ngamaconsi emhlabathini we-sandy clay loam. I-ginger yokuhweba i-Z. officinale ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalombili: 38.3 t/ha weziqu ezingaphansi komhlaba (rhizomes) ezisanda kuvunwa no-8.8 t/ha wezisomisiwe endleleni enamanzi anele; i-African ginger yayiwuhlobo oluhlukile olunezinombolo ezihlukile. Akunikezwanga ukuminyana kwezitshalo okuhambisana nalezi zibalo, ngakho akukho kg/plant noma ukuguqulwa kokomisa kwasekhaya okubaliwe. Isifinyezo sithi insimu evulekile, kanti ingxenye ethi Methods icacisa ukuvikelwa emvuleni; izimo ziyagcinwa.
rows.st: Teko ya Pretoria Hillcrest e sireleditsweng puleng, ka 2015/16 le 2016/17, ka nosetso ya marothodi mobung wa sandy clay loam. Ginger ya kgwebo ya Z. officinale dikgweding tse robedi: 38.3 t/ha tsa dikutu tse ka tlasa mobu (rhizomes) tse foreshe le 8.8 t/ha tsa tse ommeng mokgweng o noseditsweng hantle; African ginger e ne e le mofuta o fapaneng o nang le dipalo tse fapaneng. Ha ho palo ya dimela ka sebaka e tsamaellanang le dipalo tsena e fuweng, kahoo ha ho kg/plant kapa phetoho ya ho omisa ya lelapa e balwang. Kgutsufatso e re tshimo e bulehileng, empa Methods e hlalosa tshireletso puleng; maemo a bolokwa.
rows.ts: Ndzingo wa Pretoria Hillcrest lowu sirheleriweke eka mpfula, hi 2015/16 ni 2016/17, hi ku cheleta hi mathonsi eka misava ya sandy clay loam. Ginger ya bindzu ya Z. officinale eka tin’hweti ta nhungu: 38.3 t/ha ta swirho swa ximilana leswi vuriwaka rhizomes leswintshwa ni 8.8 t/ha ta leswi omeke eka maendlelo lama cheletiweke kahle; African ginger a yi ri muxaka wun’wana lowu nga ni tinhlayo tin’wana. Ku hava nhlayo ya swimila endhawini leyi fambelanaka ni tinhlayo leti leyi nyikiweke, hikokwalaho ku hava kg/plant kumbe ku cinca ka ku omisa ka le kaya leswi hlayiwaka. Nkatsakanyo wu vula nsimu leyi pfulekeke, kasi Methods yi veka leswaku ku sirheleriwile eka mpfula; swiyimo swa hlayisiwa.
rows.ve: Ndingo ya Pretoria Hillcrest yo tsireledzwaho kha mvula, nga 2015/16 na 2016/17, hu tshi sheledzwa nga mathonsi kha mavu a sandy clay loam. Ginger ya bindu ya Z. officinale kha miṅwedzi ya malo: 38.3 t/ha dza tsinde dza fhasi ha mavu (rhizomes) ntswa na 8.8 t/ha dza dzo omaho kha maitele o sheledzwaho zwavhuḓi; African ginger yo vha i luṅwe lushaka lu re na mbalo dzo fhambanaho. A hu na tshivhalo tsha zwimela fhethu tshi tendelanaho na mbalo idzi tsho ṋewaho, nga zwenezwo a hu na kg/plant kana tshanduko ya u omisa ya muṱa dzi vhalelwaho. Manweledzo a ri tsimu yo vuleaho, ngeno Methods i tshi bula u tsireledzwa kha mvula; nyimele dzi a vhulungwa.

rows.english: Extension identifies culinary ginger rhizomes used as spice, preserves and beverages. Florida planting and harvest months are not imported into the South African calendar.
rows.zu: Ezokweluleka kwezolimo zihlonza iziqu ze-ginger ezingaphansi komhlaba ezisetshenziswa ekuphekeni njengezinongo, okugciniwe neziphuzo. Izinyanga zokutshala nezokuvuna zase-Florida azifakwa ekhalendeni laseNingizimu Afrika.
rows.st: Tataiso ya katoloso ya temo e hlwaya dikutu tse ka tlasa mobu tsa ginger tse sebediswang e le senoko, dijo tse bolokilweng le dinomaphodi. Dikgwedi tsa ho jala le tsa kotulo tsa Florida ha di kenngwe khalendareng ya Afrika Borwa.
rows.ts: Vukorhokeri bya switsundzuxo swa vurimi byi tiva swirho swa ginger leswi vuriwaka rhizomes leswi tirhisiwaka tani hi swinun’hwerisi, swakudya leswi hlayisiweke ni swakunwa. Tin’hweti to byala ni to tshovela ta Florida a ti nghenisiwi eka khalendara ya Afrika-Dzonga.
rows.ve: Nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi i topola tsinde dza fhasi ha mavu dza ginger dzi shumiswaho kha u bika sa zwitunguli, zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho na zwinwiwa. Miṅwedzi ya u ṱavha na ya khaṋo ya Florida a i dzheniswi kha khaḽenda ya Afrika Tshipembe.

rows.english: The author abstract recommends harvest seven to eight months after planting; it is a rhizome crop-cycle duration, not a full-bearing tree age.
rows.zu: Isifinyezo sombhali sincoma ukuvuna ngemva kwezinyanga eziyisikhombisa kuya kweziyisishiyagalombili zokutshala; lokhu kuwubude bomjikelezo wesitshalo esineziqu ezingaphansi komhlaba, akuyona iminyaka yesihlahla esikhiqiza ngokugcwele.
rows.st: Kgutsufatso ya mongodi e kgothaletsa kotulo dikgwedi tse supileng ho isa ho tse robedi kamora ho jala; ena ke nako ya potoloho ya sejalo sa dikutu tse ka tlasa mobu, eseng dilemo tsa sefate se hlahisang ka botlalo.
rows.ts: Nkatsakanyo wa mutsari wu bumabumela ku tshovela tin’hweti ta nkombo ku fika eka nhungu endzhaku ko byala; lowu i nkarhi wa xirhendzevutana xa xibyariwa xa rhizomes, a hi malembe ya nsinya lowu tswalaka hi ku helela.
rows.ve: Manweledzo a muṅwali a themendela khaṋo miṅwedzi ya sumbe u swika kha malo nga murahu ha u ṱavha; uhu ndi vhulapfu ha mutevhe wa tshiliṅwa tsha tsinde dza fhasi ha mavu, a si miṅwaha ya muri une wa aṋwa nga vhuḓalo.

rows.english: SANBI describes dry, slightly sweet ripe pulp. Fruit remaining on leafless trees March–August is persistence, not a verified six-month picking season.
rows.zu: I-SANBI ichaza inyama evuthiwe eyomile enoshukela omncane. Ukusala kwezithelo ezihlahleni ezingenamaqabunga ngo-Mashi–Agasti kusho ukuhlala kwazo lapho, akusona isikhathi sokuvuna sezinyanga eziyisithupha esiqinisekisiwe.
rows.st: SANBI e hlalosa nama e butswitseng e ommeng e nang le monate o monyane. Ditholwana tse salang difateng tse se nang makgasi ka Hlakubele–Phata ke ho tswela pele ho ba teng, eseng sehla se netefaditsweng sa kotulo sa dikgwedi tse tsheletseng.
rows.ts: SANBI yi hlamusela nyama leyi vupfeke leyi omeke leyi tsokombelaka katsongo. Mihandzu leyi salaka eka misinya leyi nga riki na matluka hi Nyenyankulu–Mhawuri i ku ya mahlweni yi ri kona, a hi nguva leyi tiyisisiweke ya ku tshovela ya tin’hweti ta tsevu.
rows.ve: SANBI i ṱalutshedza ṋama yo vhibvaho yo omaho i ḓifhaho zwiṱuku. Mitshelo i salaho kha miri i si na maṱari nga Ṱhafamuhwe–Ṱhangule ndi u dzula hayo henefho, a si tshifhinga tsho khwaṱhisedzwaho tsha khaṋo tsha miṅwedzi ya rathi.

fieldBindings.english: Exact identity; no confirmed household food part

The checked primary assessment establishes exact identity and South African distribution only. It does not establish edible parts, food-use preparation, picking dates or yield; claims for a different Lycium species are not transferred.
Documented berry-use caution
This explicit caution prevents routine household-food forecasting. Sporadic all-year fruiting is not promoted to an edible-food availability calendar.
Macadamia output at named ages — approximate WIS references

Year 4 Beaumont: approximately 0.6–0.8 kg/tree (the year-4 basis is not explicit); year 5: 2–10 kg/tree Wet In Shell (WIS); year 8: about 16 kg/tree; year 13–14: up to 35 kg/tree WIS. SAMAC says area differences are guaranteed. This is a source reference, not a validated local schedule; it cannot seed edible kernel kg or a universal interpolated curve.
Macadamia establishment depends on propagation

Grafted stock: first nuts around 3–5 years, depending on variety; seedlings usually 10–12 years and sometimes longer. SAMAC recommends removing flowers until year 3 during establishment. The existing KZN guide 4–5-year first-bearing reference remains qualified; nursery propagation must be recorded before applying it.
Apple year 3 — Langkloof enterprise-budget output

Langkloof, Little Karoo, sandy loam: budgeted year 3 product quantity 10,000 kg/ha. This is a commercial enterprise-budget assumption, not a field measurement. The budget gives no matched tree density, rootstock or cultivar; do not convert to kg/tree, apply it to an isolated young tree or interpolate other ages. Citation uses table excerpts: the total is in the Quantity column, and the apple product-income rows use Kg; the one-hectare land basis is stated in the heading.

Citation uses table excerpts: the total is in the Quantity column, and the apple product-income rows use Kg; the one-hectare land basis is stated in the heading.
Grafted mango establishment — regional guide

Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
Annual edible leaf and fruit crop
This is an annual, not a fruit tree. The account describes boiled leaves as a spinach substitute and pickling. It supplies no food harvest duration, kg/plant or exact leaf calendar.
The source describes bright orange-red mature fruit. It does not give a picking calendar.
SANBI reports culinary uses but also toxic constituents and poisoning concerns. A preparation report is not a complete safe household recipe.
Historical processed fat, not a fresh-fruit forecast

Historical food use concerns the fatty berry coating, not a generic fresh sweet berry. No validated household extraction method, recovered food yield or storage life is established. Source coating/oil percentages are not assigned as processing conversion factors.
Pod development, not a young green-pod picking calendar

This botanical description discusses pods that become brown at maturity. The separate harvesting section requires young, tender, green pods for food and supplies no calendar for that stage. March–April is retained as pod-development phenology, not a confirmed young-pod picking season or leaf calendar.
Exact fruit identity and variability

The institutional species reference distinguishes fruiting forms and variable breeding systems. Ripe fruits are used as food; a black-fruited tree must not silently inherit this identity or the legal status of another Morus species.
South African taxonomic cultivation record
The museum lists M. nigra as cultivated in southern Africa and distinguishes naturalised Morus taxa. It gives no ripe-harvest months or quantified yield.
Fruit maturity and water context

Institutional management reference links dry roots to early fruit drop. It contains a non-local 15-year substantial-bearing statement; that is not a South African first-crop age and is not used as a forecast.
Annual plantation output

KZN plantation reference per year: conservative 20–25 t/ha, average 25–30 t/ha, good 40+ t/ha. This is annual area production; it is not the weight of one bunch or a measured age-yield curve for three plants in a banana circle.
Cultivar, planting and crop cycle

The KZN guide gives 13–20 months for both the first planting-to-harvest cycle and subsequent harvest-to-harvest cycles. It lists different commercial densities for Williams, Grand Nain and Chinese Cavendish.
